akhfash:5-5.t: He said: ﴿أَلا إِنَّهُمْ يَثْنُونَ صُدُورَهُمْ﴾. Some read (تَثْنَوْنِي صُدوُرُهم), putting it on the pattern "تَفْعَوْعِلُ", like "تَعْجَوْجِلُ"; and it is the reading of al-Aʿmash*.

akhfash:8-8.t: He said: ﴿إِلَىٰ أُمَّةٍ مَّعْدُودَةٍ﴾: "الأُمَّةُ" here is a period of time, as He said (وَادَّكَرَ بَعْدَ أُمَّةٍ).

akhfash:10-11.t:
He said: ﴿إِنَّهُ لَفَرِحٌ فَخُورٌ إِلاَّ ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُواْ﴾: He made it excluded from [the category of] the beginning of the speech, in the sense of "وَلكنّ" (but) [i.e. a disjoined exception]. They have done this even with what belongs to the beginning of the speech, and put it in the accusative. The poet said [in the basīṭ metre, and it is the two hundred and thirty-first poetic witness]:
يا صاحِبَيَّ أَلا لاحَيَّ بالوادِي * إِلاَّ عَبيداً قُعُوداً بَيْنَ أَوْتادِ
(O my two companions, there is no living soul in the valley except slaves sitting among tent-pegs.)
The Arabs recite it with the accusative.

akhfash:15-15.t: He said: ﴿مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلْحَيَاةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتَهَا نُوَفِّ﴾: (كانَ) is in the position of the jussive, and its apodosis is (نُوَفِّ).

akhfash:17-17.t:
He said: ﴿وَمِن قَبْلِهِ كِتَابُ مُوسَىٰ إِمَاماً وَرَحْمَةً﴾: [accusative] as the predicate of a definite noun [i.e. as a ḥāl].
And He said ﴿فَلاَ تَكُ فِي مِرْيَةٍ مِّنْهُ﴾, and some read (مُرْيَةٍ); it takes kasra or ḍamma, and they are two dialects.
And He said ﴿أَفَمَن كَانَ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِ وَيَتْلُوهُ شَاهِدٌ مِّنْهُ﴾, leaving the khabar (predicate) implied.
And He said ﴿فَٱلنَّارُ مَوْعِدُهُ﴾, making the Fire itself the appointed place, whereas the appointment is really in it, just as the Arabs say "الليلةُ الهِلالُ" (tonight is the new moon). Like it is (إِنَّ مَوْعِدَهُمُ ٱلصُّبْحُ).

akhfash:24-24.t: He said: ﴿مَثَلُ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ كَٱلأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلأَصَمِّ﴾; he says: "like the likeness of the blind and the deaf".

akhfash:27-27.t: He said: ﴿إِلاَّ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ أَرَاذِلُنَا بَادِيَ ٱلرَّأْيِ﴾, i.e. in outward opinion. It is not hamzated, because it is from "بَدا" "يَبْدُو", i.e. to appear. Some read (بادِىء الرَأْيِ), i.e. in what one begins with of opinion (at first thought).

akhfash:32-32.t: He said: ﴿قَالُواْ يٰنُوحُ قَدْ جَادَلْتَنَا فَأَكْثَرْتَ جِدَالَنَا﴾, and some read (جَدَلَنا); they are two dialects.

akhfash:40-40.t:
He said: ﴿قُلْنَا ٱحْمِلْ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ﴾: He made the "two pairs" the two kinds, males and females. Yūnus claimed that the poet's words [in the ṭawīl metre, and it is the two hundred and thirty-second poetic witness]:
وَأَنْتَ امْرُؤٌ تَعْدُو عَلَى كُلِّ غرّةٍ * فَتُخْطِىءُ فِيها مَرَّةً وَتُصِيبُ
(You are a man who pounces on every unguarded moment, sometimes missing and sometimes hitting the mark.)
refer to the wolf; and this is more far-fetched than that.

akhfash:41-41.t: [He said:] ﴿وَقَالَ ٱرْكَبُواْ فِيهَا بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ مَجْريٱهَا وَمُرْسَاهَا﴾ — [with ḍamma] if you derive it from "أَجْرَيْتُ" and "أَرْسَيْتُ". [Translator's note: the Qur'anic text quoted has «مَجْرَاهَا» with fatḥa; the comment appears to describe the reading «مُجْرَاهَا».] Some read (مَجْراها وَمَرساها) when deriving it from "جَرَيت" (I ran). And some read (مُجْرِيها ومُرْسِيها), because they wanted to make it an adjective of Allah, Mighty and Majestic.

akhfash:43-43.t:
He said: ﴿سَآوِيۤ إِلَىٰ جَبَلٍ يَعْصِمُنِي﴾: he gave (سَآوِى) the cut (hamzat al-qaṭʿ) alif because it is "أَفْعَلُ" (first person), referring to himself.
And He said ﴿لاَعَاصِمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ مِنْ أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ إِلاَّ مَن رَّحِمَ﴾. It may be in the sense of "لاذا عِصْمَةٍ" (none possessing protection), i.e. protected; and (إِلاَّ مَنْ رَحِمَ) may be nominative as a badal (substitute) for "العاصِم".

akhfash:44-44.t: He said: ﴿وَغِيضَ ٱلْمَآءُ﴾, because you say "غِضْتُهُ" (I made it subside), so "أَنَا أَغِيضُهُ"; and you say "غَاضَتْهُ الأَرْحَامُ" (the wombs diminished it), so "هِيَ تَغِيضُه"; and He said ﴿وَمَا تَغِيضُ ٱلأَرْحَامُ﴾. As for (الجُودِيُّ), it is doubled because it is the yāʾ of relation (nisba), as though it were related to "الجُود", like your saying "البَصْرِيّ" (Basran) and "الكُوفِيّ" (Kufan).

akhfash:46-46.t: He said: ﴿إِنَّهُ عَمَلٌ غَيْرُ صَالِحٍ﴾ with tanwīn, because when He said — and Allah knows best — ﴿لاَ تَسْأَلْنِـي مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ﴾, it had the meaning of "أَنْ تَسْأَلِني" (your asking me); so He said ﴿إِنَّهُ عَمَلٌ غَيْرُ صَالِحٍ فَلاَ تَسْأَلْنِـي مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ﴾. Some read (عَمِلَ غَيْرَ صالِحٍ), and that is how we read.

akhfash:48-48.t: He said: ﴿وَأُمَمٌ سَنُمَتِّعُهُمْ﴾: nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject), like your saying "ضَرَبْتُ زَيْداً وعَمْرُو لِقيتُه" (I struck Zayd, and ʿAmr — I met him), as a mubtadaʾ.

akhfash:54-54.t: He said: ﴿إِن نَّقُولُ إِلاَّ ٱعْتَرَاكَ بَعْضُ آلِهَتِنَا﴾: by way of quotation (ḥikāya). You say: "ما أَقُولُ إِلا: ضَرَبَكَ عَمْروٌ" (I say only: ʿAmr struck you) and "ما أَقُولُ إِلاّ: قامَ زَيْدٌ" (I say only: Zayd stood).

akhfash:64-64.t: He said: ﴿هَـٰذِهِ نَاقَةُ ٱللَّهِ لَكُمْ آيَةً﴾: accusative as the predicate of a definite noun [i.e. as a ḥāl].

akhfash:66-66.t: He said: ﴿وَمِنْ خِزْيِ يَوْمِئِذٍ﴾: He annexed (خِزْي) to "اليوم" and so put it in the genitive, and annexed "اليوم" to "إذ" and so put it in the genitive. Some read (يَوْمَئِذِ) with fatḥa, because he made it a single noun and put the inflection at its end.

akhfash:68-68.t:
He said: ﴿أَلاَ إِنَّ ثَمُودَ كَفرُواْ رَبَّهُمْ﴾. It is written with an alif in the muṣḥaf; it was declined (triptote) only because "ثمودَ" was made the name of the clan or the name of their ancestor.
Whoever does not decline it makes it the name of the tribe. This [verse] has been read undeclined; only those instances of it containing the alif were read declined, and that is how we read. It is permissible to decline all of it throughout the Qur'an and in speech, because if it is the name of the clan or the ancestor, it is a masculine noun which ought to be declined.

akhfash:70-70.t: He said: ﴿نَكِرَهُمْ﴾, because you say "نَكِرْتُ الرجل" and "أَنْكَرْتُهُ" (I found the man strange).

akhfash:71-71.t: He said: ﴿فَبَشَّرْنَاهَا بِإِسْحَاقَ وَمِن وَرَآءِ إِسْحَاقَ يَعْقُوبَ﴾: nominative as a mubtadaʾ; and it has been read with fatḥa on the sense of ﴿وَبِيَعْقُوبَ مِنْ وراءِ إِسْحاقَ﴾ (and of Yaʿqūb after Isḥāq), but it is a diptote [so its genitive appears with fatḥa].

akhfash:72-72.t:
He said: ﴿قَالَتْ يَٰوَيْلَتَىٰ أَأَلِدُ وَأَنَاْ عَجُوزٌ﴾. When you pause you say (يا وليتاه), because this alif is light; it is like the alif of lamentation (alif al-nudba), so it is too faint to stand at the pause, and a hāʾ is put after it to make it clearer and to carry the voice further. That is because when the alif is between two letters it has an echo, like a sound inside something that reverberates in it and so becomes fuller and clearer. But you do not pause on this word [with hāʾ] in the Qur'an, out of dislike of departing from the written text. It has been mentioned that one may pause on the alif of lamentation; if that is correct, you pause on the alif.
And He said ﴿وَهَـٰذَا بَعْلِي شَيْخاً﴾; in the reading of Ibn Masʿūd it is (شَيْخٌ). That may be on the basis of saying "هُوَ شيخ" (he is an old man), as though it explained after the first statement was complete; or it may give a single predicate about both, like your saying "هذا أَخْضَرُ أَحْمَرُ" (this is green-red); or by making her word (بعلى) a badal (substitute) for (هذا), so that it becomes the mubtadaʾ and "الشيخ" becomes its khabar. The poet said [in the rajaz metre, and it is the twenty-second poetic witness]:
مَنْ يَكُ ذَابَتٍّ فَهذا بَتِّى * مُقَيِّظٌ مُصيِّفٌ مُشَتِّى
(Whoever has a cloak — this is my cloak, for the hot season, the summer and the winter.)

akhfash:74-74.t: He said: ﴿فَلَمَّا ذَهَبَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ٱلرَّوْعُ﴾, which is fright. One says "أَفْرخَ رَوَعُكَ" (may your fright depart) and "أُلْقِيَ في رُوِعي", i.e. in my mind. [So] "الرُوْعُ" is the heart and the mind, and "الرَّوْعُ" is fright.

akhfash:78-78.t:
He said: ﴿هَـٰؤُلاۤءِ بَنَاتِي هُنَّ أَطْهَرُ لَكُمْ﴾, nominative. ʿĪsā [ibn ʿUmar] used to read (هُنَّ أَطْهَرَ لكم), and this cannot be; one puts in the accusative only the khabar of a verb that cannot do without a khabar, when between the noun and its khabar there are these pronouns called "faṣl" (separator), i.e. "هِيَ", "هُوَ" and "هُنّ". They claimed that the accusative is also the reading of al-Ḥasan.
And He said ﴿فَاتَّقُواْ اللًّهَ وَلاَ تُخْزُونِ فِي ضَيْفِي﴾, because "الضَيْفَ" (guest) may be singular or plural. You say "هؤلاء ضَيْفي" (these are my guests) and "هذا ضَيْفي" (this is my guest), just as you say "هَؤُلاءِ جُنُبٌ" and "هذا جُنُبٌ" (ritually impure), and "هؤلاء عَدُوٌّ" and "هذا عَدُوٌّ" (enemy).

akhfash:80-80.t: He said: ﴿لَوْ أَنَّ لِي بِكُمْ قُوَّةً﴾, leaving "لكان" (it would be …) implied.

akhfash:81-81.t: He said: ﴿إِلاَّ ٱمْرَأَتَكَ﴾; he says ﴿فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ﴾ ﴿إِلاَّ ٱمْرَأَتَكَ﴾, accusative. Some read (إِلاَّ امْرَأَتُكَ), nominative, construing it with "turning round", i.e. "none of you shall turn round except your wife".

akhfash:82-83.t: He said: ﴿وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ مَّنْضُودٍ مُّسَوَّمَةً﴾, accusative with tanwīn. "المَنْضُودُ" is an adjective of "السِّجِّيلِ", and "المُسَوَّمَةُ" is an adjective of "الحجارَةِ"; that is why it is accusative.

akhfash:87-87.t: He said: ﴿أَصَلَوٰتُكَ تَأْمُرُكَ أَن نَّتْرُكَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءابَاؤُنَآ أَوْ أَن نَّفْعَلَ فِيۤ أَمْوَالِنَا مَا نَشَاءُ﴾; he says: "that* we abandon … and that we do with our wealth what we will". The meaning is not "does your prayer command you that we do with our wealth what we will", because that is not what he commanded them. Some read (تَشاءُ), meaning Shuʿayb.

akhfash:100-100.t: He said: ﴿مِنْهَا قَآئِمٌ وَحَصِيدٌ﴾, meaning "ومحصود" (harvested), like "الجريح" and "المجروح" (wounded).

akhfash:101-101.t: He said: ﴿وَمَا زَادُوهُمْ غَيْرَ تَتْبِيبٍ﴾, because it is the maṣdar of "تَبَّبوُهُم" "تَتْبِيبا" (they brought them to ruin).

akhfash:105-105.t: He said: ﴿لاَ تَكَلَّمُ نَفْسٌ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ﴾: its meaning is "تتفَعَّلُ"; originally it would be "تَتَكَلَّمُ", but they found the meeting of the two tāʾs heavy and dropped the second of them, because it is the one that is weakened, so it has the better claim to be dropped. And in such as (تَذَكَّرُون), assimilation makes it quiescent. If it is said: "Why was the tāʾ not assimilated here into the dhāl, with a connecting alif put before it, as you said 'اِذَّكَّرُوا'?" — it is because this alif occurs only in the imperative and in every verb whose meaning is "فعل" (past); as for "يَفْعَلُ" and "تَفْعَلُ" (imperfect), no.

akhfash:111-111.t: He said: ﴿وَأَنَّ كُـلاًّ﴾, heavy; and the people of Medina read (وإِنْ كُلاًّ), lightening (إنْ) and making it govern, just as "لَمْ يَكُ" governs although you have lightened it from "يَكُنْ". ﴿لَّمَّا لَيُوَفِّيَنَّهُمْ رَبُّكَ أَعْمَالَهُمْ﴾: the lām that is with (ما) is the lām that enters after "إنّ", and the second lām is that of the oath. [Translator's note: the source prints «وَأَنَّ» with fatḥa and «بعد أن»; the Qur'anic text has «وَإِنَّ».]

akhfash:113-113.t: He said: ﴿وَلاَ تَرْكَنُوۤاْ﴾, because it is from "رَكَنَ" "يَرْكَنُ"; if you wish, you may say "وَلاَ تَرْكُنوا", deriving it from "رَكَنَ" "يَرْكُنُ".

akhfash:114-114.t:
He said: ﴿طَرَفَيِ ٱلنَّهَارِ﴾: he gave the yāʾ a vowel because it was quiescent and met a quiescent letter, and most often a quiescent letter is given kasra, as in ﴿صاحِبَيِ السِّجّنِ).
And He said {وَزُلَفاً مِّنَ ٱلْلَّيْلِ﴾, because it is a plural: you say "زُلْفَة", "زُلُفاتٌ" and "زُلَفْ".

akhfash:120-120.t: He said: ﴿وَكُـلاًّ نَّقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنْبَاءِ ٱلرُّسُلِ﴾: [accusative] by "نقص" (We relate); ﴿مَا نُثَبِّتُ بِهِ فُؤَادَكَ﴾ (كلاّ). [Translator's note: the source sets (كلاّ) after this phrase without comment; presumably ما is meant as a badal (substitute) for كلاّ.]

akhfash:123-123.t: [He said:] ﴿وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَيْهِ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ [with yāʾ, يعملون] when he does not include the Prophet — Allah bless him — among them. Some read (تَعْمَلُون) because He meant the Prophet — Allah bless him — together with them, or He said to him: "Say to them ﴿وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ﴾". [Translator's note: the source prints both readings with tāʾ; the first, contrasted reading is presumably «يَعْمَلُونَ».]

celaleyn:1-1.t: ﴿الر﴾ Allah knows best what He means by that. This is ﴿كِتَابٌ أُحْكِمَتْ آيَاتُهُ﴾ with wondrous arrangement and marvellous meanings, ﴿ثُمَّ فُصِّلَتْ﴾ made clear with rulings, stories and admonitions, ﴿مِنْ لَدُنْ حَكِيمٍ خَبِيرٍ﴾ Allah,

celaleyn:2-2.t: ﴿أَلَّا﴾ i.e. بِأَنْ لَا ("that … not") ﴿تَعْبُدُوا إِلَّا اللَّهَ إِنَّنِي لَكُمْ مِنْهُ نَذِيرٌ﴾ of punishment if you disbelieve ﴿وَبَشِيرٌ﴾ of reward if you believe,

celaleyn:3-3.t: ﴿وَأَنِ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ﴾ for shirk, ﴿ثُمَّ تُوبُوا﴾ return ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ through obedience; ﴿يُمَتِّعْكُمْ﴾ in this world ﴿مَتَاعًا حَسَنًا﴾ with a good life and ample provision ﴿إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى﴾ which is death, ﴿وَيُؤْتِ﴾ in the Hereafter ﴿كُلَّ ذِي فَضْلٍ﴾ in deeds ﴿فَضْلَهُ﴾ its recompense. ﴿وَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا﴾ — in it one of the two tāʾs is omitted [i.e. تَتَوَلَّوْا], i.e. you turn away — ﴿فَإِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ كَبِيرٍ﴾ which is the Day of Resurrection.

celaleyn:4-4.t: ﴿إِلَى اللَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ﴾ and among it are reward and punishment. And it was revealed — as al-Bukhārī narrated from Ibn ʿAbbās — about those who were too shy to relieve themselves or have intercourse and so be exposed to the sky; and it is said: about the hypocrites.

celaleyn:5-5.t: ﴿أَلَا إِنَّهُمْ يَثْنُونَ صُدُورَهُمْ لِيَسْتَخْفُوا مِنْهُ﴾ i.e. from Allah. ﴿أَلَا حِينَ يَسْتَغْشُونَ ثِيَابَهُمْ﴾ cover themselves with them, ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾ He, the Exalted, ﴿مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ﴾ so their hiding is of no avail. ﴿إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ﴾ i.e. what is in the hearts.

celaleyn:6-6.t: ﴿وَمَا مِنْ﴾ redundant (zāʾida) ﴿دَابَّةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ which is whatever moves upon it ﴿إِلَّا عَلَى اللَّهِ رِزْقُهَا﴾ He has guaranteed it, as a bounty from Him, Exalted is He; ﴿وَيَعْلَمُ مُسْتَقَرَّهَا﴾ its dwelling in this world, or [in] the loins, ﴿وَمُسْتَوْدَعَهَا﴾ after death, or in the womb. ﴿كُلٌّ﴾ of what has been mentioned ﴿فِي كِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ﴾ clear, which is the Preserved Tablet.

celaleyn:7-7.t: ﴿وَهُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ﴾ the first of which is Sunday and the last Friday, ﴿وَكَانَ عَرْشُهُ﴾ before creating them ﴿عَلَى الْمَاءِ﴾ — and it [the water] is upon the back of the wind — ﴿لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ﴾ attached (mutaʿalliq) to خَلَقَ, i.e. He created them and the benefits and interests for you in them in order to test you ﴿أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا﴾ i.e. most obedient to Allah. ﴿وَلَئِنْ قُلْتَ﴾ O Muhammad, to them: ﴿إِنَّكُمْ مَبْعُوثُونَ مِنْ بَعْدِ الْمَوْتِ لَيَقُولَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا إِنْ﴾ [meaning] not (مَا) ﴿هَذَا﴾ Quran that speaks of resurrection, and what you say, ﴿إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ﴾ clear; and in one reading [سَاحِرٌ] ("a sorcerer"), in which case the one pointed to is the Prophet ﷺ.

celaleyn:8-8.t: ﴿وَلَئِنْ أَخَّرْنَا عَنْهُمُ الْعَذَابَ إِلَى﴾ the coming of ﴿أُمَّةٍ﴾ times ﴿مَعْدُودَةٍ لَيَقُولُنَّ﴾ in mockery: ﴿مَا يَحْبِسُهُ﴾ what prevents it from coming down? Allah the Exalted said: ﴿أَلَا يَوْمَ يَأْتِيهِمْ لَيْسَ مَصْرُوفًا﴾ averted ﴿عَنْهُمْ وَحَاقَ﴾ will descend ﴿بِهِمْ مَا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ﴾ of punishment.

celaleyn:9-9.t: ﴿وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَا الْإِنْسَانَ﴾ the disbeliever ﴿مِنَّا رَحْمَةً﴾ wealth and health, ﴿ثُمَّ نَزَعْنَاهَا مِنْهُ إِنَّهُ لَيَئُوسٌ﴾ despairing of the mercy of Allah, ﴿كَفُورٌ﴾ intensely ungrateful to Him.

celaleyn:10-10.t: ﴿وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَاهُ نَعْمَاءَ بَعْدَ ضَرَّاءَ﴾ poverty and hardship ﴿مَسَّتْهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ ذَهَبَ السَّيِّئَاتُ﴾ the misfortunes ﴿عَنِّي﴾ — and he does not anticipate their [the blessings'] ceasing, nor give thanks for them. ﴿إِنَّهُ لَفَرِحٌ﴾ exultant ﴿فَخُورٌ﴾ boastful toward people about what he has been given,

celaleyn:11-11.t: ﴿إِلَّا﴾ but (لَكِنِ) ﴿الَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا﴾ in adversity ﴿وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ﴾ in prosperity — ﴿أُولَئِكَ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ﴾ which is Paradise.

celaleyn:12-12.t: ﴿فَلَعَلَّكَ﴾ O Muhammad ﴿تَارِكٌ بَعْضَ مَا يُوحَى إِلَيْكَ﴾ and so do not convey it to them because they make light of it, ﴿وَضَائِقٌ بِهِ صَدْرُكَ﴾ at reciting it to them, because of ﴿أَنْ يَقُولُوا لَوْلَا﴾ why not (هَلَّا) ﴿أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ كَنْزٌ أَوْ جَاءَ مَعَهُ مَلَكٌ﴾ confirming him, as we proposed? ﴿إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ نَذِيرٌ﴾ so your only duty is conveying, not bringing what they propose; ﴿وَاللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَكِيلٌ﴾ guardian, and He will recompense them.

celaleyn:13-13.t: ﴿أَمْ﴾ rather (بَلْ) ﴿يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ﴾ i.e. the Quran? ﴿قُلْ فَأْتُوا بِعَشْرِ سُوَرٍ مِثْلِهِ﴾ in eloquence and rhetorical excellence, ﴿مُفْتَرَيَاتٍ﴾ for you are eloquent Arabs like me — He challenged them with these first, then with a single sura — ﴿وَادْعُوا﴾ for assistance in that ﴿مَنِ اسْتَطَعْتُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ﴾ i.e. other than Him, ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ﴾ in [saying] that it is a fabrication.

celaleyn:14-14.t: ﴿فَإِنْ لَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا لَكُمْ﴾ i.e. those whom you called for assistance, ﴿فَاعْلَمُوا﴾ — an address to the idolaters — ﴿أَنَّمَا أُنْزِلَ﴾ bound up ﴿بِعِلْمِ اللَّهِ﴾ and is not a fabrication against Him, ﴿وَأَنْ﴾ lightened (mukhaffafa), i.e. أَنَّهُ ("that [the matter is]") ﴿لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ﴾ after this decisive proof? — i.e. submit [in Islam]!

celaleyn:15-15.t: ﴿مَنْ كَانَ يُرِيدُ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتَهَا﴾ by persisting in shirk — and it is said it is about those who show off — ﴿نُوَفِّ إِلَيْهِمْ أَعْمَالَهُمْ﴾ i.e. the recompense of the good they did, such as charity and maintaining ties of kinship, ﴿فِيهَا﴾ by expanding their provision for them, ﴿وَهُمْ فِيهَا﴾ i.e. in this world ﴿لَا يُبْخَسُونَ﴾ will not be diminished in anything.

celaleyn:16-16.t: ﴿أُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ إِلَّا النَّارُ وَحَبِطَ﴾ has come to nothing ﴿مَا صَنَعُوا﴾ [with the implied object] هُ ﴿فِيهَا﴾ i.e. in the Hereafter, so there is no reward for it; ﴿وَبَاطِلٌ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ﴾.

celaleyn:17-17.t: ﴿أَفَمَنْ كَانَ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ﴾ clear proof ﴿مِنْ رَبِّهِ﴾ — and he is the Prophet ﷺ, or the believers; and it [the clear proof] is the Quran — ﴿وَيَتْلُوهُ﴾ followed by ﴿شَاهِدٌ﴾ to its truth ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ i.e. from Allah, and he is Gabriel, ﴿وَمِنْ قَبْلِهِ﴾ the Quran ﴿كِتَابُ مُوسَى﴾ the Torah, a witness to it as well, ﴿إِمَامًا وَرَحْمَةً﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial) — [is he] like one who is not so? No. ﴿أُولَئِكَ﴾ i.e. those who are upon clear proof ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ﴾ i.e. the Quran, so theirs is Paradise; ﴿وَمَنْ يَكْفُرْ بِهِ مِنَ الْأَحْزَابِ﴾ all the disbelievers ﴿فَالنَّارُ مَوْعِدُهُ فَلَا تَكُ فِي مِرْيَةٍ﴾ doubt ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ about the Quran. ﴿إِنَّهُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّكَ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ﴾ i.e. the people of Mecca ﴿لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾.

celaleyn:18-18.t: ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ i.e. no one ﴿أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرَى عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا﴾ by ascribing a partner and a child to Him. ﴿أُولَئِكَ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَى رَبِّهِمْ﴾ on the Day of Resurrection, among all creation, ﴿وَيَقُولُ الْأَشْهَادُ﴾ plural of شَاهِد — they are the angels who testify for the messengers that they conveyed, and against the disbelievers that they denied: ﴿هَؤُلَاءِ الَّذِينَ كَذَبُوا عَلَى رَبِّهِمْ أَلَا لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَى الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ the idolaters,

celaleyn:19-19.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ يَصُدُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ﴾ the religion of Islam ﴿وَيَبْغُونَهَا﴾ seek the way [to be] ﴿عِوَجًا﴾ crooked; ﴿وَهُمْ بِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ﴾ a tawkīd (emphasis) ﴿كَافِرُونَ﴾.

celaleyn:20-20.t: ﴿أُولَئِكَ لَمْ يَكُونُوا مُعْجِزِينَ﴾ Allah ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ﴾ i.e. other than Him ﴿مِنْ أَوْلِيَاءَ﴾ helpers to protect them from His punishment. ﴿يُضَاعَفُ لَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ﴾ for misleading others. ﴿مَا كَانُوا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ السَّمْعَ﴾ to the truth ﴿وَمَا كَانُوا يُبْصِرُونَ﴾ i.e. because of their excessive aversion to it, it is as if they were unable to do that.

celaleyn:21-21.t: ﴿أُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾ because they end up in the Fire, which is everlasting for them, ﴿وَضَلَّ﴾ vanished ﴿عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوا يَفْتَرُونَ﴾ against Allah, in claiming a partner.

celaleyn:22-22.t: ﴿لَا جَرَمَ﴾ truly ﴿أَنَّهُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ هُمُ الْأَخْسَرُونَ﴾.

celaleyn:23-23.t: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَأَخْبَتُوا﴾ were at rest and assured, or turned in repentance, ﴿إِلَى رَبِّهِمْ أُولَئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ﴾.

celaleyn:24-24.t: ﴿مَثَلُ﴾ the description of ﴿الْفَرِيقَيْنِ﴾ the disbelievers and the believers ﴿كَالْأَعْمَى وَالْأَصَمِّ﴾ — this is the likeness of the disbeliever — ﴿وَالْبَصِيرِ وَالسَّمِيعِ﴾ — this is the likeness of the believer. ﴿هَلْ يَسْتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًا﴾ No. ﴿أَفَلَا تَذَّكَّرُونَ﴾ — in it the tāʾ of the original form is assimilated into the dhāl — will you not take admonition? [تَذَكَّرُونَ].

celaleyn:25-25.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِ أَنِّي﴾ i.e. بِأَنِّي ("[saying] that I"); and in one reading with kasra, on the basis of the omission of "saying" [إِنِّي] — ﴿لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ﴾ clear in warning,

celaleyn:26-26.t: ﴿أَنْ﴾ i.e. بِأَنْ ("that") ﴿لَا تَعْبُدُوا إِلَّا اللَّهَ إِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ if you worship other than Him ﴿عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ﴾ painful, in this world and the Hereafter.

celaleyn:27-27.t: ﴿فَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ﴾ — they were the nobles —: ﴿مَا نَرَاكَ إِلَّا بَشَرًا مِثْلَنَا﴾ and you have no superiority over us; ﴿وَمَا نَرَاكَ اتَّبَعَكَ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ هُمْ أَرَاذِلُنَا﴾ our lowliest, such as weavers and cobblers, ﴿بَادِئَ الرَّأْيِ﴾ with hamza and without it [بَادِيَ], i.e. at first, without reflecting about you; it is accusative as an adverb (ẓarf), i.e. at the time their first opinion arose. ﴿وَمَا نَرَى لَكُمْ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ فَضْلٍ﴾ by which you would deserve to be followed by us; ﴿بَلْ نَظُنُّكُمْ كَاذِبِينَ﴾ in the claim of messengership. They included his people with him in the address.

celaleyn:28-28.t: ﴿قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ أَرَأَيْتُمْ﴾ tell me: ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ﴾ clear proof ﴿مِنْ رَبِّي وَآتَانِي رَحْمَةً﴾ prophethood ﴿مِنْ عِنْدِهِ فَعَمِيَتْ﴾ was hidden ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ — and in one reading with a doubled mīm and passive [فَعُمِّيَتْ] — ﴿أَنُلْزِمُكُمُوهَا﴾ shall we compel you to accept it ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ لَهَا كَارِهُونَ﴾? We are not able to do that.

celaleyn:29-29.t: ﴿وَيَا قَوْمِ لَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ﴾ for conveying the message ﴿مَالًا﴾ that you would give me. ﴿إِنْ﴾ [meaning] not (مَا) ﴿أَجْرِيَ﴾ my reward ﴿إِلَّا عَلَى اللَّهِ وَمَا أَنَا بِطَارِدِ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾ as you ordered me. ﴿إِنَّهُمْ مُلَاقُوا رَبِّهِمْ﴾ through the resurrection, and He will recompense them and take [their due] for them from whoever wronged and drove them away; ﴿وَلَكِنِّي أَرَاكُمْ قَوْمًا تَجْهَلُونَ﴾ the outcome of your affair.

celaleyn:30-30.t: ﴿وَيَا قَوْمِ مَنْ يَنْصُرُنِي﴾ will protect me ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ i.e. His punishment ﴿إِنْ طَرَدْتُهُمْ﴾ — i.e. I would have no helper. ﴿أَفَلَا﴾ so why not (فَهَلَّا) ﴿تَذَّكَّرُونَ﴾ — with the second tāʾ of the original form assimilated into the dhāl: take admonition [تَذَكَّرُونَ].

celaleyn:31-31.t: ﴿وَلَا أَقُولُ لَكُمْ عِنْدِي خَزَائِنُ اللَّهِ وَلَا﴾ [that] I ﴿أَعْلَمُ الْغَيْبَ وَلَا أَقُولُ إِنِّي مَلَكٌ﴾ rather, I am a human being like you; ﴿وَلَا أَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ تَزْدَرِي﴾ hold in contempt ﴿أَعْيُنُكُمْ لَنْ يُؤْتِيَهُمُ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾ their hearts. ﴿إِنِّي إِذًا﴾ if I said that ﴿لَمِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾.

celaleyn:32-32.t: ﴿قَالُوا يَا نُوحُ قَدْ جَادَلْتَنَا﴾ disputed with us ﴿فَأَكْثَرْتَ جِدَالَنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَا﴾ with, of punishment, ﴿إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ﴾ in it.

celaleyn:33-33.t: ﴿قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَأْتِيكُمْ بِهِ اللَّهُ إِنْ شَاءَ﴾ to hasten it for you, for its matter rests with Him, not with me; ﴿وَمَا أَنْتُمْ بِمُعْجِزِينَ﴾ able to escape Allah.

celaleyn:34-34.t: ﴿وَلَا يَنْفَعُكُمْ نُصْحِي إِنْ أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَنْصَحَ لَكُمْ إِنْ كَانَ اللَّهُ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُغْوِيَكُمْ﴾ i.e. your being led astray; and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is indicated by وَلَا يَنْفَعُكُمْ نُصْحِي. ﴿هُوَ رَبُّكُمْ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ﴾. Allah the Exalted said:

celaleyn:35-35.t: ﴿أَمْ﴾ [meaning] "rather, do…?" (بَلْ أَ) ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾ i.e. the disbelievers of Mecca ﴿افْتَرَاهُ﴾ Muhammad invented the Quran? ﴿قُلْ إِنِ افْتَرَيْتُهُ فَعَلَيَّ إِجْرَامِي﴾ my sin, i.e. its punishment, ﴿وَأَنَا بَرِيءٌ مِمَّا تُجْرِمُونَ﴾ of your crime in attributing fabrication to me.

celaleyn:36-36.t: ﴿وَأُوحِيَ إِلَى نُوحٍ أَنَّهُ لَنْ يُؤْمِنَ مِنْ قَوْمِكَ إِلَّا مَنْ قَدْ آمَنَ فَلَا تَبْتَئِسْ﴾ grieve ﴿بِمَا كَانُوا يَفْعَلُونَ﴾ of shirk. So he supplicated against them with his words {رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ} etc., and Allah answered his supplication and said:

celaleyn:37-37.t: ﴿وَاصْنَعِ الْفُلْكَ﴾ the ship ﴿بِأَعْيُنِنَا﴾ under Our sight and protection ﴿وَوَحْيِنَا﴾ Our command, ﴿وَلَا تُخَاطِبْنِي فِي الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا﴾ disbelieved, [asking] that they not be destroyed; ﴿إِنَّهُمْ مُغْرَقُونَ﴾.

celaleyn:38-38.t: ﴿وَيَصْنَعُ الْفُلْكَ﴾ — relating a past situation (ḥikāyat ḥāl māḍiya) — ﴿وَكُلَّمَا مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ مَلَأٌ﴾ a group ﴿مِنْ قَوْمِهِ سَخِرُوا مِنْهُ﴾ mocked him. ﴿قَالَ إِنْ تَسْخَرُوا مِنَّا فَإِنَّا نَسْخَرُ مِنْكُمْ كَمَا تَسْخَرُونَ﴾ when we are saved and you are drowned.

celaleyn:39-39.t: ﴿فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ﴾ — relative, the object of knowing — ﴿يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ﴾ descends ﴿عَلَيْهِ عَذَابٌ مُقِيمٌ﴾ lasting.

celaleyn:40-40.t: ﴿حَتَّى﴾ marking the end of the building ﴿إِذَا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا﴾ to destroy them ﴿وَفَارَ التَّنُّورُ﴾ of the baker, with water — and that was a sign for Noah — ﴿قُلْنَا احْمِلْ فِيهَا﴾ in the ship ﴿مِنْ كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ﴾ male and female, i.e. of all their kinds [مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجَيْنِ] ﴿اثْنَيْنِ﴾ a male and a female — and it is the object. In the story, Allah gathered for Noah the beasts of prey, the birds and others, and he began striking with his hands in each kind; his right hand would fall on the male and his left on the female, and he would carry it into the ship. ﴿وَأَهْلَكَ﴾ i.e. his wife and children, ﴿إِلَّا مَنْ سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ الْقَوْلُ﴾ i.e. of them, [decreeing] destruction — and that was his wife and his son Canaan, unlike Shem, Ham and Japheth, whom he carried along with their three wives — ﴿وَمَنْ آمَنَ وَمَا آمَنَ مَعَهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلٌ﴾ — it is said they were six men and their wives; and it is said all who were in the ship were eighty, half of them men and half women.

celaleyn:41-41.t: ﴿وَقَالَ﴾ Noah: ﴿ارْكَبُوا فِيهَا بِسْمِ اللَّهِ مَجْرِيهَا وَمُرْسَاهَا﴾ with fatḥa on both mīms and with ḍamma on them [وَمُرْسِيهَا]; two maṣdars (verbal nouns), i.e. its sailing and its anchoring, i.e. the end of its voyage. ﴿إِنَّ رَبِّي لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾ in that He did not destroy us.

celaleyn:42-42.t: ﴿وَهِيَ تَجْرِي بِهِمْ فِي مَوْجٍ كَالْجِبَالِ﴾ in height and size, ﴿وَنَادَى نُوحٌ ابْنَهُ﴾ Canaan, ﴿وَكَانَ فِي مَعْزِلٍ﴾ apart from the ship: ﴿يَا بُنَيَّ ارْكَبْ مَعَنَا وَلَا تَكُنْ مَعَ الْكَافِرِينَ﴾.

celaleyn:43-43.t: ﴿قَالَ سَآوِي إِلَى جَبَلٍ يَعْصِمُنِي﴾ will protect me ﴿مِنَ الْمَاءِ قَالَ لَا عَاصِمَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ أَمْرِ اللَّهِ﴾ His punishment, ﴿إِلَّا﴾ but (لَكِنَّ) ﴿مَنْ رَحِمَ﴾ Allah — he is the one protected. Allah the Exalted said: ﴿وَحَالَ بَيْنَهُمَا الْمَوْجُ فَكَانَ مِنَ الْمُغْرَقِينَ﴾.

celaleyn:44-44.t: ﴿وَقِيلَ يَا أَرْضُ ابْلَعِي مَاءَكِ﴾ which welled up from you — so it drank it, but not what had come down from the sky, [which became] rivers and seas — ﴿وَيَا سَمَاءُ أَقْلِعِي﴾ hold back from raining — so it held back. ﴿وَغِيضَ﴾ was diminished ﴿الْمَاءُ وَقُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ﴾ the matter of the destruction of Noah's people was completed, ﴿وَاسْتَوَتْ﴾ the ship came to rest ﴿عَلَى الْجُودِيِّ﴾ a mountain in al-Jazīra near Mosul, ﴿وَقِيلَ بُعْدًا﴾ destruction ﴿لِلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ the disbelievers.

celaleyn:45-45.t: ﴿وَنَادَى نُوحٌ رَبَّهُ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ ابْنِي﴾ Canaan ﴿مِنْ أَهْلِي﴾ and You promised me their rescue, ﴿وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ الْحَقُّ﴾ in which there is no breach, ﴿وَأَنْتَ أَحْكَمُ الْحَاكِمِينَ﴾ the most knowing and most just of them.

celaleyn:46-46.t: ﴿قَالَ﴾ the Exalted: ﴿يَا نُوحُ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ أَهْلِكَ﴾ who are saved, or of the people of your religion. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ i.e. your asking Me for his rescue ﴿عَمَلٌ غَيْرُ صَالِحٍ﴾ for he is a disbeliever, and there is no rescue for the disbelievers. In one reading [عَمِلَ], with kasra on the mīm of عَمِلَ, a verb, and [غَيْرَ] in the accusative, so the pronoun refers to his son. ﴿فَلَا تَسْأَلَنِّ﴾ with the doubled and the single [nūn] [فَلَا تَسْأَلْنِ] ﴿مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ﴾ about rescuing your son. ﴿إِنِّي أَعِظُكَ أَنْ تَكُونَ مِنَ الْجَاهِلِينَ﴾ by asking what you do not know.

celaleyn:47-47.t: ﴿قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ﴾ from ﴿أَنْ أَسْأَلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَإِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِي﴾ what has slipped from me ﴿وَتَرْحَمْنِي أَكُنْ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ﴾.

celaleyn:48-48.t: ﴿قِيلَ يَا نُوحُ اهْبِطْ﴾ go down from the ship ﴿بِسَلَامٍ﴾ or with a greeting ﴿مِنَّا وَبَرَكَاتٍ﴾ good things ﴿عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَى أُمَمٍ مِمَّنْ مَعَكَ﴾ in the ship, i.e. of their children and descendants — and they are the believers. ﴿وَأُمَمٌ﴾ in the nominative, of those with you, ﴿سَنُمَتِّعُهُمْ﴾ in this world, ﴿ثُمَّ يَمَسُّهُمْ مِنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ﴾ in the Hereafter — and they are the disbelievers.

celaleyn:49-49.t: ﴿تِلْكَ﴾ i.e. these ayahs containing the story of Noah ﴿مِنْ أَنْبَاءِ الْغَيْبِ﴾ reports of what was hidden from you ﴿نُوحِيهَا إِلَيْكَ﴾ O Muhammad. ﴿مَا كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُهَا أَنْتَ وَلَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْ قَبْلِ هَذَا﴾ Quran. ﴿فَاصْبِرْ﴾ in conveying and [upon] the harm of your people, as Noah was patient. ﴿إِنَّ الْعَاقِبَةَ﴾ the praiseworthy ﴿لِلْمُتَّقِينَ﴾.

celaleyn:50-50.t: ﴿وَ﴾ We sent ﴿إِلَى عَادٍ أَخَاهُمْ﴾ of the tribe ﴿هُودًا قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ﴾ affirm His oneness; ﴿مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ﴾ redundant (zāʾida) ﴿إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ إِنْ﴾ [meaning] not (مَا) ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾ in your worship of idols ﴿إِلَّا مُفْتَرُونَ﴾ lying against Allah.

celaleyn:51-51.t: ﴿يَا قَوْمِ لَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ﴾ for [calling to] tawḥīd ﴿أَجْرًا إِنْ﴾ [meaning] not (مَا) ﴿أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى الَّذِي فَطَرَنِي﴾ created me. ﴿أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ﴾

celaleyn:52-52.t: ﴿وَيَا قَوْمِ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ﴾ for shirk, ﴿ثُمَّ تُوبُوا﴾ return ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ through obedience; ﴿يُرْسِلِ السَّمَاءَ﴾ rain — they had been deprived of it — ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ مِدْرَارًا﴾ pouring abundantly, ﴿وَيَزِدْكُمْ قُوَّةً إِلَى﴾ along with (مَعَ) ﴿قُوَّتِكُمْ﴾ through wealth and children; ﴿وَلَا تَتَوَلَّوْا مُجْرِمِينَ﴾ idolaters.

celaleyn:53-53.t: ﴿قَالُوا يَا هُودُ مَا جِئْتَنَا بِبَيِّنَةٍ﴾ proof of what you say, ﴿وَمَا نَحْنُ بِتَارِكِي آلِهَتِنَا عَنْ قَوْلِكَ﴾ i.e. because of your saying, ﴿وَمَا نَحْنُ لَكَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾.

celaleyn:54-54.t: ﴿إِنْ﴾ [meaning] not (مَا) ﴿نَقُولُ﴾ about you ﴿إِلَّا اعْتَرَاكَ﴾ has afflicted you ﴿بَعْضُ آلِهَتِنَا بِسُوءٍ﴾ and deranged you because you insulted them, so you are raving. ﴿قَالَ إِنِّي أُشْهِدُ اللَّهَ﴾ over me ﴿وَاشْهَدُوا أَنِّي بَرِيءٌ مِمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ﴾ with Him

celaleyn:55-55.t: ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ فَكِيدُونِي﴾ scheme to destroy me ﴿جَمِيعًا﴾ you and your idols, ﴿ثُمَّ لَا تُنْظِرُونَ﴾ give me no respite.

celaleyn:56-56.t: ﴿إِنِّي تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمْ مَا مِنْ﴾ redundant (zāʾida) ﴿دَابَّةٍ﴾ a living soul that moves upon the earth ﴿إِلَّا هُوَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا﴾ i.e. its Owner and Subduer, so there is no benefit or harm except by His permission. The forelock is singled out for mention because whoever is seized by his forelock is in utmost abasement. ﴿إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ﴾ i.e. the path of truth and justice.

celaleyn:57-57.t: ﴿فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا﴾ — in it one of the two tāʾs is omitted, i.e. [if] you turn away — ﴿فَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتُكُمْ مَا أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِ إِلَيْكُمْ وَيَسْتَخْلِفُ رَبِّي قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ وَلَا تَضُرُّونَهُ شَيْئًا﴾ by your shirk. ﴿إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ حَفِيظٌ﴾ watchful.

celaleyn:58-58.t: ﴿وَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا﴾ Our punishment, ﴿نَجَّيْنَا هُودًا وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ﴾ guidance ﴿مِنَّا وَنَجَّيْنَاهُمْ مِنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ﴾ severe.

celaleyn:59-59.t: ﴿وَتِلْكَ عَادٌ﴾ — a pointing to their remains, i.e. travel through the land and look at them. Then He described their condition, saying: ﴿جَحَدُوا بِآيَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَصَوْا رُسُلَهُ﴾ — plural, because whoever disobeys one messenger has disobeyed all the messengers, since they share in the root of what they brought, which is tawḥīd — ﴿وَاتَّبَعُوا﴾ i.e. the lowly ones ﴿أَمْرَ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ﴾ obstinately resisting the truth, of their leaders.

celaleyn:60-60.t: ﴿وَأُتْبِعُوا فِي هَذِهِ الدُّنْيَا لَعْنَةً﴾ from people ﴿وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَمَةِ﴾ a curse before the heads of all creatures. ﴿أَلَا إِنَّ عَادًا كَفَرُوا﴾ denied ﴿رَبَّهُمْ أَلَا بُعْدًا﴾ from the mercy of Allah ﴿لِعَادٍ قَوْمِ هُودٍ﴾.

celaleyn:61-61.t: ﴿وَ﴾ We sent ﴿إِلَى ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ﴾ of the tribe ﴿صَالِحًا قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ﴾ affirm His oneness; ﴿مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ هُوَ أَنْشَأَكُمْ﴾ began your creation ﴿مِنَ الْأَرْضِ﴾ by creating your father Adam from it, ﴿وَاسْتَعْمَرَكُمْ فِيهَا﴾ made you inhabitants dwelling in it; ﴿فَاسْتَغْفِرُوهُ﴾ for shirk, ﴿ثُمَّ تُوبُوا﴾ return ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ through obedience. ﴿إِنَّ رَبِّي قَرِيبٌ﴾ to His creation through His knowledge, ﴿مُجِيبٌ﴾ to whoever asks Him.

celaleyn:62-62.t: ﴿قَالُوا يَا صَالِحُ قَدْ كُنْتَ فِينَا مَرْجُوًّا﴾ we hoped you would be a chief ﴿قَبْلَ هَذَا﴾ which has come from you. ﴿أَتَنْهَانَا أَنْ نَعْبُدَ مَا يَعْبُدُ آبَاؤُنَا﴾ of idols? ﴿وَإِنَّنَا لَفِي شَكٍّ مِمَّا تَدْعُونَا إِلَيْهِ﴾ of tawḥīd ﴿مُرِيبٍ﴾ casting into doubt.

celaleyn:63-63.t: ﴿قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ﴾ clear proof ﴿مِنْ رَبِّي وَآتَانِي مِنْهُ رَحْمَةً﴾ prophethood, ﴿فَمَنْ يَنْصُرُنِي﴾ will protect me ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ i.e. His punishment ﴿إِنْ عَصَيْتُهُ فَمَا تَزِيدُونَنِي﴾ by ordering me to do that ﴿غَيْرَ تَخْسِيرٍ﴾ leading astray.

celaleyn:64-64.t: ﴿وَيَا قَوْمِ هَذِهِ نَاقَةُ اللَّهِ لَكُمْ آيَةً﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), whose governing word (ʿāmil) is the [meaning of] pointing. ﴿فَذَرُوهَا تَأْكُلْ فِي أَرْضِ اللَّهِ وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوءٍ﴾ hamstringing ﴿فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابٌ قَرِيبٌ﴾ if you hamstring it.

celaleyn:65-65.t: ﴿فَعَقَرُوهَا﴾ — Qudār hamstrung it at their command — ﴿فَقَالَ﴾ Ṣāliḥ: ﴿تَمَتَّعُوا﴾ live ﴿فِي دَارِكُمْ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ﴾ then you will be destroyed. ﴿ذَلِكَ وَعْدٌ غَيْرُ مَكْذُوبٍ﴾ in it (فِيهِ), [i.e. not lied about].

celaleyn:66-66.t: ﴿فَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا﴾ to destroy them, ﴿نَجَّيْنَا صَالِحًا وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ﴾ — they were four thousand — ﴿بِرَحْمَةٍ مِنَّا وَ﴾ We saved them ﴿مِنْ خِزْيِ يَوْمِئِذٍ﴾ with kasra on the mīm as declension (iʿrāb), and with fatḥa as indeclinability (bināʾ), because it is annexed to an indeclinable (mabnī) word — and this is the more common. ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الْقَوِيُّ الْعَزِيزُ﴾ the Overpowering.

celaleyn:67-67.t: ﴿وَأَخَذَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا الصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دِيَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ﴾ fallen on their knees, dead,

celaleyn:68-68.t: ﴿كَأَنْ﴾ lightened (mukhaffafa), and its noun is omitted, i.e. كَأَنَّهُمْ ("as if they") ﴿لَمْ يَغْنَوْا﴾ had dwelt ﴿فِيهَا﴾ in their abode. ﴿أَلَا إِنَّ ثَمُودَ كَفَرُوا رَبَّهُمْ أَلَا بُعْدًا لِثَمُودَ﴾ with full declension (ṣarf) and without it [لِثَمُودًا], according to the sense of the clan or the tribe.

celaleyn:69-69.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ بِالْبُشْرَى﴾ of Isaac, and Jacob after him. ﴿قَالُوا سَلَامًا﴾ a maṣdar (verbal noun). ﴿قَالَ سَلَامٌ﴾ upon you. ﴿فَمَا لَبِثَ أَنْ جَاءَ بِعِجْلٍ حَنِيذٍ﴾ roasted.

celaleyn:70-70.t: ﴿فَلَمَّا رَأَى أَيْدِيَهُمْ لَا تَصِلُ إِلَيْهِ نَكِرَهُمْ﴾ in the sense of أَنْكَرَهُمْ (he found them strange) ﴿وَأَوْجَسَ﴾ concealed in himself ﴿مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً﴾ fear. ﴿قَالُوا لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّا أُرْسِلْنَا إِلَى قَوْمِ لُوطٍ﴾ to destroy them.

celaleyn:71-71.t: ﴿وَامْرَأَتُهُ﴾ i.e. Abraham's wife, Sarah, ﴿قَائِمَةٌ﴾ serving them, ﴿فَضَحِكَتْ﴾ rejoicing at their destruction. ﴿فَبَشَّرْنَاهَا بِإِسْحَاقَ وَمِنْ وَرَاءِ﴾ after ﴿إِسْحَاقَ يَعْقُوبَ﴾ his son; she would live until she saw him.

celaleyn:72-72.t: ﴿قَالَتْ يَا وَيْلَتَى﴾ — a word said at a grave matter; the alif is substituted for the yāʾ of the first-person possessive — ﴿أَأَلِدُ وَأَنَا عَجُوزٌ﴾ I am ninety-nine years old ﴿وَهَذَا بَعْلِي شَيْخًا﴾ he is a hundred or [and] twenty years old [Translator's note: the text reads «مِائَةٌ أَوْ وَعِشْرُونَ», which appears garbled; the usual text of al-Jalalayn reads «مِائَةٌ وَعِشْرُونَ», "a hundred and twenty"] — it is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), and what governs it is the pointing contained in ذَا. ﴿إِنَّ هَذَا لَشَيْءٌ عَجِيبٌ﴾ that a child should be born to two very old people.

celaleyn:73-73.t: ﴿قَالُوا أَتَعْجَبِينَ مِنْ أَمْرِ اللَّهِ﴾ His power? ﴿رَحْمَتُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ O ﴿أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ﴾ the house of Abraham. ﴿إِنَّهُ حَمِيدٌ﴾ praised ﴿مَجِيدٌ﴾ noble.

celaleyn:74-74.t: ﴿فَلَمَّا ذَهَبَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الرَّوْعُ﴾ the fear ﴿وَجَاءَتْهُ الْبُشْرَى﴾ of the child, he began ﴿يُجَادِلُنَا﴾ to dispute with Our messengers ﴿فِي﴾ the matter of ﴿قَوْمِ لُوطٍ﴾.

celaleyn:75-75.t: ﴿إِنَّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ لَحَلِيمٌ﴾ much given to forbearance, ﴿أَوَّاهٌ مُنِيبٌ﴾ ever-returning [to Allah]. He said to them: "Will you destroy a town in which there are three hundred believers?" They said: "No." He said: "Will you then destroy a town in which there are two hundred believers?" They said: "No." He said: "Will you then destroy a town in which there are forty believers?" They said: "No." He said: "Will you then destroy a town in which there are fourteen believers?" They said: "No." He said: "Then what if there is one believer in it?" They said: "No." He said: "Lot is in it." They said: "We know best who is in it" etc. When he prolonged his dispute with them, they said:

celaleyn:76-76.t: ﴿يَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ أَعْرِضْ عَنْ هَذَا﴾ dispute. ﴿إِنَّهُ قَدْ جَاءَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ﴾ to destroy them, ﴿وَإِنَّهُمْ آتِيهِمْ عَذَابٌ غَيْرُ مَرْدُودٍ﴾.

celaleyn:77-77.t: ﴿وَلَمَّا جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًا سِيءَ بِهِمْ﴾ he was grieved because of them ﴿وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًا﴾ in heart, because they were handsome of face, in the form of guests, so he feared his people [would harm] them. ﴿وَقَالَ هَذَا يَوْمٌ عَصِيبٌ﴾ hard.

celaleyn:78-78.t: ﴿وَجَاءَهُ قَوْمُهُ﴾ when they learned of them ﴿يُهْرَعُونَ﴾ hastening ﴿إِلَيْهِ وَمِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ before their coming ﴿كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ السَّيِّئَاتِ﴾ which was approaching men from behind. ﴿قَالَ﴾ Lot: ﴿يَا قَوْمِ هَؤُلَاءِ بَنَاتِي﴾ so marry them; ﴿هُنَّ أَطْهَرُ لَكُمْ فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ﴾ disgrace me ﴿فِي ضَيْفِي﴾ my guests. ﴿أَلَيْسَ مِنْكُمْ رَجُلٌ رَشِيدٌ﴾ who enjoins what is right and forbids what is wrong?

celaleyn:79-79.t: ﴿قَالُوا لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا لَنَا فِي بَنَاتِكَ مِنْ حَقٍّ﴾ need, ﴿وَإِنَّكَ لَتَعْلَمُ مَا نُرِيدُ﴾ of approaching men.

celaleyn:80-80.t: ﴿قَالَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِي بِكُمْ قُوَّةً﴾ strength ﴿أَوْ آوِي إِلَى رُكْنٍ شَدِيدٍ﴾ a clan to help me, I would have struck you down. When the angels saw that,

celaleyn:81-81.t: ﴿قَالُوا يَا لُوطُ إِنَّا رُسُلُ رَبِّكَ لَنْ يَصِلُوا إِلَيْكَ﴾ with harm. ﴿فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ﴾ a portion ﴿مِنَ اللَّيْلِ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنْكُمْ أَحَدٌ﴾ lest he see the terrible thing that befalls them, ﴿إِلَّا امْرَأَتُكَ﴾ in the nominative, a badal (substitute) from أَحَدٌ; and in one reading in the accusative [إِلَّا امْرَأَتَكَ], an exception from "your family", i.e. do not travel by night with her. ﴿إِنَّهُ مُصِيبُهَا مَا أَصَابَهُمْ﴾. It is said he did not take her out; and it is said she went out and turned round and said "O my people!", and a stone came to her and killed her. He asked them about the time of their destruction, and they said: ﴿إِنَّ مَوْعِدَهُمُ الصُّبْحُ﴾. He said: "I want sooner than that." They said: ﴿أَلَيْسَ الصُّبْحُ بِقَرِيبٍ﴾.

celaleyn:82-82.t: ﴿فَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا﴾ to destroy them, ﴿جَعَلْنَا عَالِيَهَا﴾ i.e. their towns ﴿سَافِلَهَا﴾ i.e. in that Gabriel raised them to the sky and dropped them upside down onto the earth, ﴿وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا حِجَارَةً مِنْ سِجِّيلٍ﴾ clay baked in fire ﴿مَنْضُودٍ﴾ in succession,

celaleyn:83-83.t: ﴿مُسَوَّمَةً﴾ marked, bearing the name of the one at whom it is thrown, ﴿عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) for it. ﴿وَمَا هِيَ﴾ the stones, or their land, ﴿مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ i.e. the people of Mecca ﴿بِبَعِيدٍ﴾.

celaleyn:84-84.t: ﴿وَ﴾ We sent ﴿إِلَى مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًا قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ﴾ affirm His oneness; ﴿مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ وَلَا تَنْقُصُوا الْمِكْيَالَ وَالْمِيزَانَ إِنِّي أَرَاكُمْ بِخَيْرٍ﴾ a blessing that makes you independent of cheating in measure; ﴿وَإِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ if you do not believe ﴿عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ مُحِيطٍ﴾ encompassing you, destroying you — describing the day with it is figurative (majāz), because it occurs in it.

celaleyn:85-85.t: ﴿وَيَا قَوْمِ أَوْفُوا الْمِكْيَالَ وَالْمِيزَانَ﴾ make them complete ﴿بِالْقِسْطِ﴾ with justice, ﴿وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا النَّاسَ أَشْيَاءَهُمْ﴾ do not diminish anything of their due, ﴿وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ﴾ by killing and other things — from عَثِيَ, with kasra on the thāʾ, [meaning] "he caused corruption"; and مُفْسِدِينَ is a ḥāl that emphasises the meaning of its governing word (ḥāl muʾakkida), تَعْثَوْا.

celaleyn:86-86.t: ﴿بَقِيَّتُ اللَّهِ﴾ His provision that remains for you after giving full measure and weight ﴿خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ﴾ than diminishing [others' due] ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ وَمَا أَنَا عَلَيْكُمْ بِحَفِيظٍ﴾ a watcher who recompenses you for your deeds; I have only been sent as a warner.

celaleyn:87-87.t: ﴿قَالُوا﴾ to him, in mockery: ﴿يَا شُعَيْبُ أَصَلَوتُكَ تَأْمُرُكَ﴾ by way of obligation ﴿أَنْ نَتْرُكَ مَا يَعْبُدُ آبَاؤُنَا﴾ of idols, ﴿أَوْ﴾ that we abandon ﴿أَنْ نَفْعَلَ فِي أَمْوَالِنَا مَا نَشَاءُ﴾? The meaning is: this is a false command to which no one calling to good would call. ﴿إِنَّكَ لَأَنْتَ الْحَلِيمُ الرَّشِيدُ﴾ — they said that in mockery.

celaleyn:88-88.t: ﴿قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّي وَرَزَقَنِي مِنْهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا﴾ lawful — shall I then mix it with the unlawful gain of diminishing and short-measuring? ﴿وَمَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُخَالِفَكُمْ﴾ and go ﴿إِلَى مَا أَنْهَاكُمْ عَنْهُ﴾ and commit it myself. ﴿إِنْ﴾ [meaning] not (مَا) ﴿أُرِيدُ إِلَّا الْإِصْلَاحَ﴾ for you, through justice, ﴿مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ وَمَا تَوْفِيقِي﴾ my ability for that and for other acts of obedience ﴿إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ﴾ I return.

celaleyn:89-89.t: ﴿وَيَا قَوْمِ لَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ﴾ let not … earn you ﴿شِقَاقِي﴾ opposition to me — the fāʿil (agent) of يَجْرِمُ; the pronoun is the first object, and the second is ﴿أَنْ يُصِيبَكُمْ مِثْلُ مَا أَصَابَ قَوْمَ نُوحٍ أَوْ قَوْمَ هُودٍ أَوْ قَوْمَ صَالِحٍ﴾ of punishment. ﴿وَمَا قَوْمُ لُوطٍ﴾ i.e. their dwellings, or the time of their destruction, ﴿مِنْكُمْ بِبَعِيدٍ﴾ so take heed.

celaleyn:90-90.t: ﴿وَاسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوا إِلَيْهِ إِنَّ رَبِّي رَحِيمٌ﴾ to the believers, ﴿وَدُودٌ﴾ loving them.

celaleyn:91-91.t: ﴿قَالُوا﴾ signalling their indifference: ﴿يَا شُعَيْبُ مَا نَفْقَهُ﴾ understand ﴿كَثِيرًا مِمَّا تَقُولُ وَإِنَّا لَنَرَاكَ فِينَا ضَعِيفًا﴾ abased; ﴿وَلَوْلَا رَهْطُكَ﴾ your clan ﴿لَرَجَمْنَاكَ﴾ with stones; ﴿وَمَا أَنْتَ عَلَيْنَا بِعَزِيزٍ﴾ too honoured to be stoned; it is only your clan who are the honoured ones.

celaleyn:92-92.t: ﴿قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ أَرَهْطِي أَعَزُّ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ so that you refrain from killing me for their sake, yet do not protect me for Allah's sake? ﴿وَاتَّخَذْتُمُوهُ﴾ i.e. Allah ﴿وَرَاءَكُمْ ظِهْرِيًّا﴾ cast behind your backs, not being mindful of Him. ﴿إِنَّ رَبِّي بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطٌ﴾ in knowledge, and He will recompense you.

celaleyn:93-93.t: ﴿وَيَا قَوْمِ اعْمَلُوا عَلَى مَكَانَتِكُمْ﴾ your [present] state; ﴿إِنِّي عَامِلٌ﴾ according to my state. ﴿سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ﴾ — relative, the object of knowing — ﴿يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَمَنْ هُوَ كَاذِبٌ وَارْتَقِبُوا﴾ await the outcome of your affair; ﴿إِنِّي مَعَكُمْ رَقِيبٌ﴾ waiting.

celaleyn:94-94.t: ﴿وَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا﴾ to destroy them, ﴿نَجَّيْنَا شُعَيْبًا وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِنَّا وَأَخَذَتِ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا الصَّيْحَةُ﴾ — Gabriel shouted at them — ﴿فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دِيَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ﴾ fallen on their knees, dead,

celaleyn:95-95.t: ﴿كَأَنْ﴾ lightened (mukhaffafa), i.e. كَأَنَّهُمْ ("as if they") ﴿لَمْ يَغْنَوْا﴾ had dwelt ﴿فِيهَا أَلَا بُعْدًا لِمَدْيَنَ كَمَا بَعِدَتْ ثَمُودُ﴾.

celaleyn:96-96.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَى بِآيَاتِنَا وَسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ﴾ manifest proof

celaleyn:97-97.t: ﴿إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَئِهِ فَاتَّبَعُوا أَمْرَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَا أَمْرُ فِرْعَوْنَ بِرَشِيدٍ﴾ sound.

celaleyn:98-98.t: ﴿يَقْدُمُ﴾ he will go before ﴿قَوْمَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَمَةِ﴾ and they will follow him as they followed him in this world, ﴿فَأَوْرَدَهُمُ﴾ and he will lead them into ﴿النَّارَ وَبِئْسَ الْوِرْدُ الْمَوْرُودُ﴾ it [is].

celaleyn:99-99.t: ﴿وَأُتْبِعُوا فِي هَذِهِ﴾ i.e. this world ﴿لَعْنَةً وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَمَةِ﴾ a curse. ﴿بِئْسَ الرِّفْدُ﴾ the aid ﴿الْمَرْفُودُ﴾ their aid [is].

celaleyn:100-100.t: ﴿ذَلِكَ﴾ what has been mentioned — a mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar (predicate) is ﴿مِنْ أَنْبَاءِ الْقُرَى نَقُصُّهُ عَلَيْكَ﴾ O Muhammad. ﴿مِنْهَا﴾ i.e. of the towns ﴿قَائِمٌ﴾ whose people perished but not it, ﴿وَ﴾ of them ﴿حَصِيدٌ﴾ perished with its people and left no trace, like crops harvested with sickles.

celaleyn:101-101.t: ﴿وَمَا ظَلَمْنَاهُمْ﴾ by destroying them without sin, ﴿وَلَكِنْ ظَلَمُوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾ through shirk. ﴿فَمَا أَغْنَتْ﴾ warded off ﴿عَنْهُمْ آلِهَتُهُمُ الَّتِي يَدْعُونَ﴾ worship ﴿مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ﴾ i.e. other than Him ﴿مِنْ﴾ redundant (zāʾida) ﴿شَيْءٍ لَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ﴾ His punishment, ﴿وَمَا زَادُوهُمْ﴾ through their worship of them ﴿غَيْرَ تَتْبِيبٍ﴾ ruin.

celaleyn:102-102.t: ﴿وَكَذَلِكَ﴾ like that seizing ﴿أَخْذُ رَبِّكَ إِذَا أَخَذَ الْقُرَى﴾ — their people are meant — ﴿وَهِيَ ظَالِمَةٌ﴾ through sins, i.e. nothing will avail them against His seizing. ﴿إِنَّ أَخْذَهُ أَلِيمٌ شَدِيدٌ﴾. The two Shaykhs [al-Bukhārī and Muslim] narrated from Abū Mūsā al-Ashʿarī, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Allah grants respite to the wrongdoer, until, when He seizes him, He does not let him escape." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited {وَكَذَلِكَ أَخْذُ رَبِّكَ} (the ayah).

celaleyn:103-103.t: ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ﴾ which has been mentioned of the stories ﴿لَآيَةً﴾ a lesson ﴿لِمَنْ خَافَ عَذَابَ الْآخِرَةِ ذَلِكَ﴾ i.e. the Day of Resurrection ﴿يَوْمٌ مَجْمُوعٌ لَهُ﴾ in which are gathered ﴿النَّاسُ وَذَلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَشْهُودٌ﴾ witnessed by all creatures.

celaleyn:104-104.t: ﴿وَمَا نُؤَخِّرُهُ إِلَّا لِأَجَلٍ مَعْدُودٍ﴾ for a time known to Allah.

celaleyn:105-105.t: ﴿يَوْمَ يَأْتِ﴾ that day, ﴿لَا تَكَلَّمُ﴾ — in it one of the two tāʾs is omitted — ﴿نَفْسٌ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ﴾ the Exalted. ﴿فَمِنْهُمْ﴾ i.e. of creation ﴿شَقِيٌّ وَ﴾ of them ﴿سَعِيدٌ﴾ — each was written in pre-eternity.

celaleyn:106-106.t: ﴿فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ شَقُوا﴾ in His knowledge, Exalted is He, ﴿فَفِي النَّارِ لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌ﴾ a loud sound ﴿وَشَهِيقٌ﴾ a faint sound,

celaleyn:107-107.t: ﴿خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ﴾ i.e. for the span of their lasting in this world, ﴿إِلَّا﴾ other than (غَيْرَ) ﴿مَا شَاءَ رَبُّكَ﴾ of addition beyond their span, which has no end; and the meaning is: abiding in it forever. ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ فَعَّالٌ لِمَا يُرِيدُ﴾.

celaleyn:108-108.t: ﴿وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ سَعِدُوا﴾ with fatḥa on the sīn and with ḍamma [سُعِدُوا] ﴿فَفِي الْجَنَّةِ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ إِلَّا﴾ other than (غَيْرَ) ﴿مَا شَاءَ رَبُّكَ﴾ as has preceded; and indicating it in their case is His saying ﴿عَطَاءً غَيْرَ مَجْذُوذٍ﴾ cut off. The interpretation given above is what is apparent, and it is free of strained construction; and Allah knows best what He means.

celaleyn:109-109.t: ﴿فَلَا تَكُ﴾ O Muhammad ﴿فِي مِرْيَةٍ﴾ doubt ﴿مِمَّا يَعْبُدُ هَؤُلَاءِ﴾ of idols — We will punish them as We punished those before them; and this is a consolation for the Prophet ﷺ. ﴿مَا يَعْبُدُونَ إِلَّا كَمَا يَعْبُدُ آبَاؤُهُمْ﴾ i.e. like their worship ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ — and We punished them. ﴿وَإِنَّا لَمُوَفُّوهُمْ﴾ like them ﴿نَصِيبَهُمْ﴾ their share of the punishment ﴿غَيْرَ مَنْقُوصٍ﴾ i.e. complete.

celaleyn:110-110.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ﴾ the Torah ﴿فَاخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ﴾ by belief and denial, like the Quran. ﴿وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾ to defer the reckoning and recompense of the creatures until the Day of Resurrection, ﴿لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ in this world, concerning what they differed over. ﴿وَإِنَّهُمْ﴾ i.e. those who deny it ﴿لَفِي شَكٍّ مِنْهُ مُرِيبٍ﴾ casting into suspicion.

celaleyn:111-111.t: ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ with the single and the doubled [nūn] [وَإِنَّ] ﴿كُلًّا﴾ i.e. all creatures ﴿لَمَا﴾ — مَا is redundant (zāʾida), and the lām is preparatory (muwaṭṭiʾa) for an implied oath, or distinguishing (fāriqa); and in one reading with a doubled [لَمَّا], in the sense of إِلَّا ("except"), in which case إِنْ is negating — ﴿لَيُوَفِّيَنَّهُمْ رَبُّكَ أَعْمَالَهُمْ﴾ i.e. their recompense. ﴿إِنَّهُ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ﴾ knowing its inward as its outward.

celaleyn:112-112.t: ﴿فَاسْتَقِمْ﴾ in acting on your Lord's command and calling to it ﴿كَمَا أُمِرْتَ﴾ ﴿وَ﴾ let there be upright ﴿مَنْ تَابَ﴾ believed ﴿مَعَكَ وَلَا تَطْغَوْا﴾ transgress the bounds of Allah. ﴿إِنَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ﴾ and He will recompense you.

celaleyn:113-113.t: ﴿وَلَا تَرْكَنُوا﴾ incline ﴿إِلَى الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا﴾ with affection, flattery or approval of their deeds, ﴿فَتَمَسَّكُمْ﴾ lest … touch you ﴿النَّارُ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ﴾ i.e. other than Him ﴿مِنْ﴾ redundant (zāʾida) ﴿أَوْلِيَاءَ﴾ to protect you from it; ﴿ثُمَّ لَا تُنْصَرُونَ﴾ you will not be protected from His punishment.

celaleyn:114-114.t: ﴿وَأَقِمِ الصَّلَوةَ طَرَفَيِ النَّهَارِ﴾ morning and evening, i.e. the dawn, noon and afternoon [prayers], ﴿وَزُلَفًا﴾ plural of زُلْفَة, i.e. a portion ﴿مِنَ اللَّيْلِ﴾ the sunset and night [prayers]. ﴿إِنَّ الْحَسَنَاتِ﴾ such as the five prayers ﴿يُذْهِبْنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ﴾ the minor sins. It was revealed about a man who kissed a woman not related to him; he informed the Prophet ﷺ and said: "Is this for me [alone]?" He said: "For all of my community, every one of them." The two Shaykhs narrated it. ﴿ذَلِكَ ذِكْرَى لِلذَّاكِرِينَ﴾ an admonition for those who take admonition.

celaleyn:115-115.t: ﴿وَاصْبِرْ﴾ O Muhammad, upon the harm of your people, or upon the prayer, ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾ through patience in obedience.

celaleyn:116-116.t: ﴿فَلَوْلَا﴾ so why not (فَهَلَّا) ﴿كَانَ مِنَ الْقُرُونِ﴾ the past nations ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ أُولُو بَقِيَّةٍ﴾ people of religion and virtue ﴿يَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْفَسَادِ فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ — what is meant by it is negation, i.e. there was not that among them — ﴿إِلَّا﴾ but (لَكِنْ) ﴿قَلِيلًا مِمَّنْ أَنْجَيْنَا مِنْهُمْ﴾ — they forbade, and so were saved; and مِنْ is explicative (li-l-bayān). ﴿وَاتَّبَعَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا﴾ by corruption and abandoning forbidding [it] ﴿مَا أُتْرِفُوا﴾ were given luxury ﴿فِيهِ وَكَانُوا مُجْرِمِينَ﴾.

celaleyn:117-117.t: ﴿وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ لِيُهْلِكَ الْقُرَى بِظُلْمٍ﴾ from Him to them ﴿وَأَهْلُهَا مُصْلِحُونَ﴾ believers.

celaleyn:118-118.t: ﴿وَلَوْ شَاءَ رَبُّكَ لَجَعَلَ النَّاسَ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً﴾ people of one religion; ﴿وَلَا يَزَالُونَ مُخْتَلِفِينَ﴾ in religion,

celaleyn:119-119.t: ﴿إِلَّا مَنْ رَحِمَ رَبُّكَ﴾ willed good for them, so they do not differ in it. ﴿وَلِذَلِكَ خَلَقَهُمْ﴾ i.e. the people of difference for it, and the people of mercy for it. ﴿وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَةُ رَبِّكَ﴾ and it is: ﴿لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ﴾ the jinn ﴿وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ﴾.

celaleyn:120-120.t: ﴿وَكُلًّا﴾ accusative by نَقُصُّ, and its tanwīn is a substitute for the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), i.e. all that is needed ﴿نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنْبَاءِ الرُّسُلِ مَا﴾ a badal (substitute) from كُلًّا ﴿نُثَبِّتُ﴾ We reassure ﴿بِهِ فُؤَادَكَ﴾ your heart. ﴿وَجَاءَكَ فِي هَذِهِ﴾ reports, or ayahs, ﴿الْحَقُّ وَمَوْعِظَةٌ وَذِكْرَى لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ — they are singled out for mention because they benefit from them in faith, unlike the disbelievers.

celaleyn:121-121.t: ﴿وَقُلْ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ اعْمَلُوا عَلَى مَكَانَتِكُمْ﴾ your [present] state; ﴿إِنَّا عَامِلُونَ﴾ according to our state — a threat to them.

celaleyn:122-122.t: ﴿وَانْتَظِرُوا﴾ the outcome of your affair; ﴿إِنَّا مُنْتَظِرُونَ﴾ that.

celaleyn:123-123.t: ﴿وَلِلَّهِ غَيْبُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ i.e. the knowledge of what is hidden in them, ﴿وَإِلَيْهِ يَرْجِعُ﴾ with the verb built for the agent, [meaning] returns, and for the object [يُرْجَعُ], [meaning] is brought back, ﴿الْأَمْرُ كُلُّهُ﴾ so He will take vengeance on whoever disobeyed. ﴿فَاعْبُدْهُ﴾ alone ﴿وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَيْهِ﴾ trust in Him, for He suffices you. ﴿وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ — He only defers them until their time; and in one reading with the "upper-dotted" letter (tāʾ) [تَعْمَلُونَ].

daas-irab:34-37.t:
﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is negating. ﴿يَنْفَعُكُمْ نُصْحِي﴾ an imperfect verb, its fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its postponed fāʿil (agent); the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿أَرَدْتُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿أَنْ أَنْصَحَ﴾ an makes the verb accusative, and an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنصح, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿كانَ اللَّهُ﴾ kāna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism), and the clause is initial. ﴿يُرِيدُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of kāna. ﴿إِنْ﴾ accusative-governing [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿إِنْ﴾ here; the word in the verse is أَنْ]. ﴿يُغْوِيَكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb in the accusative, its mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the mafʿūl bihi of يريد. ﴿هُوَ رَبُّكُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَإِلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ترجعون. ﴿تُرْجَعُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is maʿṭūf.

﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿افْتَراهُ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنِ﴾ conditional. ﴿افْتَرَيْتُهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and its clause is initial. ﴿فَعَلَيَّ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis, and a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿إِجْرامِي﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, its appearance prevented by the place being occupied by the fitting vowel; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿وَأَنَا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and أنا is mubtadaʾ. ﴿بَرِيءٌ﴾ khabar, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ composed of the preposition and the relative mā; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تجرمون. ﴿تُجْرِمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause).

﴿وَأُوحِيَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a passive past verb, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿إِلى نُوحٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أوحي. ﴿أَنَّهُ﴾ anna and its noun, and the clause is in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil of أوحي. ﴿لَنْ يُؤْمِنَ﴾ lan is an accusative-governing particle, and an imperfect verb in the accusative, and the clause is the khabar of anna. ﴿مِنْ قَوْمِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يؤمن, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿مِنْ﴾ a relative noun, the fāʿil of يؤمن, and the clause is the khabar of أنه [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿مِنْ﴾; the word in the verse is مَنْ]. ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿آمَنَ﴾ a past verb with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَبْتَئِسْ﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) with a latent fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive-governing condition. ﴿بِما﴾ relative; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تبتئس. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿يَفْعَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar.

﴿وَاصْنَعِ الْفُلْكَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb and its mafʿūl bihi with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿بِأَعْيُنِنا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَوَحْيِنا﴾ conjoined to أعيننا. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تُخاطِبْنِي﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿فِي الَّذِينَ﴾ the relative noun is genitive by في; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تخاطبني. ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿إِنَّهُمْ مُغْرَقُونَ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar, and the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl) with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:38-40.t:
﴿وَيَصْنَعُ الْفُلْكَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَكُلَّما﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and كلما is an adverb of time containing the sense of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) سخروا. ﴿مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ مَلَأٌ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the prepositions with their genitive nouns are attached to مر, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿سَخِرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to سخروا, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive-governing condition. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنْ تَسْخَرُوا﴾ in is conditional, and an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the clause is initial. ﴿مِنَّا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تسخروا. ﴿فَإِنَّا﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis, and inna and its noun, and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿نَسْخَرُ﴾ an imperfect verb with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنا. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نسخر. ﴿كَما﴾ the kāf is a preposition and mā is relative, in the position of the genitive; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نسخر. ﴿تَسْخَرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause).

﴿فَسَوْفَ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; sawfa is for the future. ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is fāʿil. ﴿مَنْ﴾ relative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَأْتِيهِ عَذابٌ﴾ an imperfect verb, its mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿يُخْزِيهِ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of عذاب. ﴿وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذابٌ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يحل. ﴿مُقِيمٌ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa).

﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) and of the genitive. ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb containing the sense of condition, attached to قلنا. ﴿جاءَ أَمْرُنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَفارَ التَّنُّورُ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿قُلْنَا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive-governing condition. ﴿احْمِلْ﴾ an imperative verb with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to احمل. ﴿مِنْ كُلٍّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿زَوْجَيْنِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ because it is dual. ﴿اثْنَيْنِ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis), genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ because it is dual [Translator's note: the source says "genitive"; as tawkīd of the accusative زوجين one would expect "accusative"]. ﴿وَأَهْلَكَ﴾ conjoined to زوجين, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a relative noun, excepted (mustathnā) by إلا, in the position of the accusative [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿مِنْ﴾; the word in the verse is مَنْ]. ﴿سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ الْقَوْلُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to سبق, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ a relative noun conjoined to أهلك. ﴿آمَنَ﴾ a past verb with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and mā is negating. ﴿آمَنَ مَعَهُ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent [Translator's note: so in the source; the fāʿil is in fact the overt قليل, as the source itself states below], and the adverb is attached to it, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿قَلِيلٌ﴾ fāʿil.

daas-irab:41-43.t:
﴿وَقالَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿ارْكَبُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) اركبوا. ﴿بِسْمِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مَجْراها﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur), and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿وَمُرْساها﴾ conjoined to مجراها. ﴿إِنَّ رَبِّي لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its two khabars, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive.

﴿وَهِيَ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of ḥāl (circumstance) and هي is mubtadaʾ. ﴿تَجْرِي﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿بِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تجري. ﴿فِي مَوْجٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تجري. ﴿كَالْجِبالِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of موج. ﴿وَنادى﴾ a past verb. ﴿نُوحٌ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿ابْنَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَكانَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and kāna, its noun omitted. ﴿فِي مَعْزِلٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿بُنَيَّ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), the yāʾ of the speaker having been dropped for lightness, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿ارْكَبْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿مَعَنا﴾ an adverb of place attached to اركب, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَكُنْ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm), its noun omitted [Translator's note: so in the source; the noun is usually taken as a latent pronoun]. ﴿مَعَ﴾ an adverb of place attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿الْكافِرِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined).

﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿سَآوِي﴾ the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness (thiql), with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿إِلى جَبَلٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to سآوي. ﴿يَعْصِمُنِي﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya) and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is an adjective of جبل. ﴿مِنَ الْماءِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يعصمني. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا﴾ the lā of generic negation, operating like inna. ﴿عاصِمَ﴾ its noun. ﴿الْيَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿مِنْ أَمْرِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿مِنَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the accusative by exception [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿مِنَ﴾; the word in the verse is مَنْ]. ﴿رَحِمَ﴾ a past verb with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَحالَ بَيْنَهُمَا الْمَوْجُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; بينهما is an adverb of place attached to حال, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿فَكانَ مِنَ الْمُغْرَقِينَ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and kāna, its noun omitted, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar, and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:44-46.t:
﴿وَقِيلَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a passive past verb, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿أَرْضُ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative by the vocative, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿ابْلَعِي﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the yāʾ is fāʿil (agent). ﴿ماءَكِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the vocative clause and the imperative clause are in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿وَيا سَماءُ﴾ conjoined to يا أرض. ﴿أَقْلِعِي﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil. ﴿وَغِيضَ الْماءُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿وَقُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ﴾ conjoined to what precedes, and parsed like it. ﴿وَاسْتَوَتْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلَى الْجُودِيِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) استوت. ﴿وَقِيلَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a passive past verb, its nāʾib fāʿil latent. ﴿بُعْداً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "بعد بعدا". ﴿لِلْقَوْمِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بعدا. ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ an adjective, genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

﴿وَنادى﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb, indeclinable on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur). ﴿نُوحٌ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿رَبَّهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَقالَ﴾ the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is explicative. ﴿رَبِّ﴾ the one addressed, with an omitted vocative particle, accusative (manṣūb) with an implied fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, which was dropped for lightness, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿إِنَّ ابْنِي﴾ inna and its noun, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ أَهْلِي﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar (predicate), and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ الْحَقُّ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and inna, its noun and its khabar, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَأَنْتَ أَحْكَمُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿الْحاكِمِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.

﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿نُوحُ﴾ the one addressed, a singular proper name, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna, and the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿لَيْسَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, its noun omitted. ﴿مِنْ أَهْلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the khabar, and the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿عَمَلٌ﴾ khabar. ﴿غَيْرُ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿صالِحٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَسْئَلْنِ﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm); the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the dropped yāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, second mafʿūl bihi, and the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿لَيْسَ﴾ a defective past verb. ﴿لَكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿بِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to علم. ﴿عِلْمٌ﴾ the noun of laysa, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna, and the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl) with no grammatical position. ﴿أَعِظُكَ﴾ a past verb [Translator's note: so in the source; أعظ is an imperfect verb] and its mafʿūl bihi, with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿أَنْ﴾ accusative-governing. ﴿تَكُونَ﴾ a defective imperfect verb, its noun omitted. ﴿مِنَ الْجاهِلِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar; an and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative by removal of the preposition.

daas-irab:47-49.t:
﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبِّ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), with an omitted vocative particle, accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, which was dropped for lightness, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿أَعُوذُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إني. ﴿بِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أعوذ. ﴿أَنْ﴾ accusative-governing. ﴿أَسْئَلَكَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the accusative; the kāf is its first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and its fāʿil is latent; an and what follows it are accusative by removal of the preposition. ﴿ما﴾ relative, second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لَيْسَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لِي﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿بِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to علم. ﴿عِلْمٌ﴾ the noun of laysa, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَإِلَّا﴾ the wāw is resumptive and in is conditional, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿تَغْفِرْ﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm); it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is initial. ﴿لِي﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تغفر. ﴿وَتَرْحَمْنِي﴾ conjoined to what precedes it; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَكُنْ﴾ a defective imperfect verb in the jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); its clause has no grammatical position because it is not joined to the fāʾ; its noun is omitted. ﴿مِنَ الْخاسِرِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the khabar.

﴿قِيلَ﴾ a passive past verb, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿نُوحُ﴾ the one addressed, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative by the vocative, and its clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿اهْبِطْ﴾ an imperative verb with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿بِسَلامٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنَّا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to سلام. ﴿وَبَرَكاتٍ﴾ conjoined to سلام. ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بركات. ﴿وَعَلى أُمَمٍ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مِمَّنْ﴾ min is a preposition and man is relative; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of أمم. ﴿مَعَكَ﴾ an adverb of place attached to an omitted ṣila, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَأُمَمٌ﴾ the wāw is resumptive and أمم is mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿سَنُمَتِّعُهُمْ﴾ the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿ثُمَّ يَمَسُّهُمْ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مِنَّا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يمسهم. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿أَلِيمٌ﴾ an adjective.

﴿تِلْكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿مِنْ أَنْباءِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿الْغَيْبِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نُوحِيها﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نوحيها. ﴿ما كُنْتَ﴾ mā is negating, and kāna and its noun, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿تَعْلَمُها﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis). ﴿وَلا قَوْمُكَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, lā is redundant (zāʾida), and قومك is conjoined to the fāʿil of تعلمها. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿هذا﴾ the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and ذا is a demonstrative and muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَاصْبِرْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّ الْعاقِبَةَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿لِلْمُتَّقِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the khabar, and the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl) with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:50-52.t:
﴿وَإِلى عادٍ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "أرسلنا". ﴿أَخاهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the omitted verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the alif because it is one of the five nouns, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿هُوداً﴾ badal (substitute) of أخاهم. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿قَوْمِ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ, which was dropped for lightness. ﴿اعْبُدُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi; the vocative clause and what follows it are the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾid) preposition. ﴿إِلهٍ﴾ genitive in form, nominative in position, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿غَيْرُهُ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) following the position. ﴿إِنْ﴾ negating. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿مُفْتَرُونَ﴾ khabar, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl.

﴿يا قَوْمِ﴾ its parsing has just preceded. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿أَسْئَلُكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its first mafʿūl bihi, with a latent fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أسألكم. ﴿أَجْراً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِنْ﴾ a particle of negation. ﴿أَجْرِيَ﴾ mubtadaʾ, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿عَلَى الَّذِي﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿فَطَرَنِي﴾ a past verb; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position. ﴿أَفَلا﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, lā is negating and the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿تَعْقِلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined).

﴿وَيا قَوْمِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes, and parsed like it. ﴿اسْتَغْفِرُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبَّكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ثُمَّ تُوبُوا﴾ conjoined to استغفروا. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to توبوا. ﴿يُرْسِلِ﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), with a latent fāʿil. ﴿السَّماءَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يرسل. ﴿مِدْراراً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَيَزِدْكُمْ﴾ conjoined to يرسل, and the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قُوَّةً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِلى قُوَّتِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَتَوَلَّوْا﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil. ﴿مُجْرِمِينَ﴾ ḥāl, accusative by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural, and the clause is maʿṭūf.

daas-irab:53-55.t:
﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿هُودُ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper name, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative by the vocative. ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿جِئْتَنا﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿بِبَيِّنَةٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) جئتنا. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and mā is negating, operating like laysa. ﴿نَحْنُ﴾ its noun. ﴿بِتارِكِي﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾid) preposition, and تاركي is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position, the khabar (predicate) of mā. ﴿آلِهَتِنا﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and nā is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَنْ قَوْلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تاركي. ﴿وَما نَحْنُ لَكَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ its parsing is like that of the preceding one.

﴿إِنْ﴾ a particle of negation. ﴿نَقُولُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿اعْتَراكَ﴾ a past verb and its fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بَعْضُ﴾ postponed fāʿil. ﴿آلِهَتِنا﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿بِسُوءٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to اعتراك. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿أُشْهِدُ اللَّهَ﴾ a passive past verb, and the Name of Majesty is mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the khabar of إني, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent [Translator's note: so in the source; أُشهِدُ is an active imperfect verb whose fāʿil is a latent "I", with the Name of Majesty as its mafʿūl bihi]. ﴿وَاشْهَدُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿أَنِّي بَرِيءٌ﴾ anna, its noun and its khabar, interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), and the clause is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi of اشهدوا. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ min is a preposition and mā is relative;
