a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بريء. ﴿تُشْرِكُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَكِيدُونِي﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive-governing condition. ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾ ḥāl. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ prohibitive. ﴿تُنْظِرُونِ﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā; the wāw is fāʿil, the nūn is for protection, and the yāʾ, dropped for lightness, is mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is maʿṭūf.

daas-irab:56-57.t:
﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿تَوَكَّلْتُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by على; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) توكلت. ﴿رَبِّي﴾ badal (substitute), and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَرَبِّكُمْ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿مِنْ دَابَّةٍ﴾ min is a redundant (zāʾid) preposition, and دابة is mubtadaʾ (subject), genitive in form and nominative in position. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿هُوَ آخِذٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the clause is the khabar of دابة. ﴿بِناصِيَتِها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to آخذ, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّ رَبِّي﴾ inna and its noun, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَلى صِراطٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿مُسْتَقِيمٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa).

﴿فَإِنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive and in is conditional. ﴿تَوَلَّوْا﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is initial, and the clause "in …" etc. is resumptive. ﴿فَقَدْ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿أَبْلَغْتُكُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أُرْسِلْتُ﴾ a passive past verb, and the tāʾ is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿بِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أرسلت, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِلَيْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَيَسْتَخْلِفُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبِّي﴾ fāʿil, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, its appearance prevented by the fitting vowel, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قَوْماً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿غَيْرَكُمْ﴾ an adjective, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is negating. ﴿تَضُرُّونَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative; the wāw is fāʿil and the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi [Translator's note: so in the source; ضرّ does not normally take two objects, and شيئا is often parsed as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object)]. ﴿إِنَّ رَبِّي﴾ inna and its noun, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلى كُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to حفيظ. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿حَفِيظٌ﴾ khabar, and the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl).

daas-irab:58-60.t:
﴿وَلَمَّا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and لما al-ḥīniyya ("when") is an adverb of time and a non-jussive-governing conditional particle. ﴿جاءَ أَمْرُنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and nā is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نَجَّيْنا هُوداً﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive-governing condition. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun conjoined to هودا. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مَعَهُ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) آمنوا, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِرَحْمَةٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نجينا. ﴿مِنَّا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of رحمة. ﴿وَنَجَّيْناهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿مِنْ عَذابٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نجيناهم. ﴿غَلِيظٍ﴾ an adjective.

﴿وَتِلْكَ عادٌ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and تلك is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf for address, and عاد is khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿جَحَدُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is an adjective of عاد or a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿بِآياتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جحدوا. ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَعَصَوْا رُسُلَهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿وَاتَّبَعُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿أَمْرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كُلِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿جَبَّارٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَنِيدٍ﴾ an adjective. ﴿وَأُتْبِعُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a passive past verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿فِي هذِهِ﴾ the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and the demonstrative is genitive by في; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أتبعوا. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ badal (substitute) of the demonstrative, genitive (majrūr) with an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur). ﴿لَعْنَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to the omitted verb أتبعوا. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of drawing attention. ﴿إِنَّ عاداً﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَفَرُوا رَبَّهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of drawing attention and of opening (istiftāḥ). ﴿بُعْداً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "بعدوا بعدا". ﴿لِعادٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بعدا. ﴿قَوْمِ﴾ badal of عاد. ﴿هُودٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:61-62.t:
﴿وَإِلى ثَمُودَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "أرسلنا", and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿أَخاهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the omitted verb, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿صالِحاً﴾ badal (substitute) of أخاهم. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) omitted [Translator's note: so in the source; elsewhere the book calls this fāʿil latent (mustatir)], and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا قَوْمِ﴾ yā is a vocative particle; قوم is the one addressed (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, which was dropped for lightness. ﴿اعْبُدُوا﴾ an imperative verb, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause, together with what precedes it, is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ما لَكُمْ﴾ mā is negating; لكم, a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾid) preposition. ﴿إِلهٍ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿غَيْرُهُ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of إله following the position, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَنْشَأَكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of هو. ﴿مِنَ الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنشأكم. ﴿وَاسْتَعْمَرَكُمْ﴾ conjoined to أنشأكم. ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to استعمركم. ﴿فَاسْتَغْفِرُوهُ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive-governing condition. ﴿ثُمَّ تُوبُوا﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to توبوا. ﴿إِنَّ رَبِّي قَرِيبٌ مُجِيبٌ﴾ inna and its noun, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and قريب and مجيب are its two khabars, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿صالِحُ﴾ the one addressed, a singular proper name, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative. ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿كُنْتَ﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿فِينا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to مرجوا. ﴿مَرْجُوًّا﴾ khabar; the clause, together with what precedes it, is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿قَبْلَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to مرجوا. ﴿هذا﴾ the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and ذا is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَتَنْهانا﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْ﴾ an accusative-governing particle. ﴿نَعْبُدَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the accusative whose fāʿil is latent; an and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative by removal of the preposition. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَعْبُدُ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿آباؤُنا﴾ fāʿil, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَإِنَّنا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and inna and its noun. ﴿لَفِي شَكٍّ﴾ the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ min is a preposition and mā is a relative noun; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to شك. ﴿تَدْعُونا﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the ṣila of the relative. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تدعونا. ﴿مُرِيبٍ﴾ an adjective of شك.

daas-irab:63-64.t:
﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿قَوْمِ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the dropped yāʾ of the speaker. ﴿أَرَأَيْتُمْ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause, together with what precedes it, is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿كُنْتُ﴾ kāna and its noun, and the clause is initial. ﴿عَلى بَيِّنَةٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّي﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of بينة, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَآتانِي﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), the yāʾ is its first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to آتاني. ﴿رَحْمَةً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis, and man is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿يَنْصُرُنِي﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ); the nūn is for protection, the yāʾ is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the khabar of man. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by min; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ينصرني. ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿عَصَيْتُهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is initial, and its apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive and mā is negating. ﴿تَزِيدُونَنِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is fāʿil, the nūn is for protection, and the yāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿غَيْرَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿تَخْسِيرٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.

﴿وَيا قَوْمِ﴾ its parsing has preceded. ﴿هذِهِ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿ناقَةُ﴾ khabar. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿آيَةً﴾ ḥāl. ﴿فَذَرُوها﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿تَأْكُلْ﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab). ﴿فِي أَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تأكل. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَمَسُّوها﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive by the dropping of the nūn, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِسُوءٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تمسوها, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذابٌ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation (al-sababiyya), and an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied an after the fāʾ of causation; the kāf is its fronted mafʿūl bihi and عذاب its postponed fāʿil. ﴿قَرِيبٌ﴾ an adjective of عذاب.

daas-irab:65-67.t:
﴿فَعَقَرُوها﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَقالَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿تَمَتَّعُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿فِي دارِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) تمتعوا, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ثَلاثَةَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to تمتعوا. ﴿أَيَّامٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿وَعْدٌ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿غَيْرُ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of وعد. ﴿مَكْذُوبٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive.

﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لما al-ḥīniyya ("when") is an adverb of time attached to جاء [Translator's note: so in the source; elsewhere the book attaches لما to its apodosis (here نجينا), since the clause after it is its muḍāf ilayhi]. ﴿جاءَ أَمْرُنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نَجَّيْنا صالِحاً﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the apodosis of لما, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the relative noun is conjoined to صالحا. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مَعَهُ﴾ an adverb of place attached to آمنوا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِرَحْمَةٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنَّا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of رحمة. ﴿وَمِنْ خِزْيِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes, and a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "نجيناكم من خزي". ﴿يَوْمِئِذٍ﴾ يوم is muḍāf ilayhi, and idh is an adverb containing the sense of condition, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ﴾ inna and its noun, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿هُوَ﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الْقَوِيُّ﴾ the first khabar of inna. ﴿الْعَزِيزُ﴾ a second khabar.

﴿وَأَخَذَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿الصَّيْحَةُ﴾ postponed fāʿil. ﴿فَأَصْبَحُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and أصبح and its noun. ﴿فِي دِيارِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جاثمين, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿جاثِمِينَ﴾ the khabar of أصبحوا, accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural, and the clause is maʿṭūf.

daas-irab:68-70.t:
﴿كَأَنْ﴾ lightened from كأن; its noun is the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَمْ﴾ a particle of negation, of the jussive and of conversion (qalb) [i.e. of the imperfect to past meaning]. ﴿يَغْنَوْا﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil (agent). ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يغنوا, and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of كأن. ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of opening (istiftāḥ) and drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿إِنَّ ثَمُودَ﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَفَرُوا رَبَّهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is the khabar. ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of opening and drawing attention. ﴿بُعْداً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "بعدوا بعدا". ﴿لِثَمُودَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بعدا, and ثمود is genitive (majrūr) by the fatḥa because it is a diptote.

﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a particle of oath and of the genitive, and the lām occurs in the answer to the omitted oath, and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿جاءَتْ رُسُلُنا إِبْراهِيمَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the tāʾ is for the feminine and nā is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause occurs as the answer to the oath. ﴿بِالْبُشْرى﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جاءت. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb) [Translator's note: so in the source; the clause قالوا is more naturally resumptive, and it is سلاما that is the object of the speech]. ﴿سَلاماً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿سَلامٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), its khabar omitted, its implied form being "عليكم", and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿فَما لَبِثَ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, mā is negating, and a past verb, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْ﴾ accusative-governing, and ﴿جاءَ﴾ a past verb; an and what follows it are in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil of لبث. ﴿بِعِجْلٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جاء. ﴿حَنِيذٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa).

﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and لما al-ḥīniyya ("when") is an adverb of time. ﴿رَأى﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَيْدِيَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿تَصِلُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تصل, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿نَكِرَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, with a latent fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive-governing condition. ﴿وَأَوْجَسَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿خِيفَةً﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا تَخَفْ﴾ lā is prohibitive, and an imperfect verb in the jussive, and the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿أُرْسِلْنا﴾ a passive past verb, and nā is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿إِلى قَوْمِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أرسلنا. ﴿لُوطٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the khabar of inna.

daas-irab:71-73.t:
﴿وَامْرَأَتُهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿قائِمَةٌ﴾ khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَضَحِكَتْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿فَبَشَّرْناها﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿بِإِسْحاقَ﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition, and إسحاق is genitive (majrūr) by the fatḥa because it is a diptote; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) بشرناها. ﴿وَمِنْ وَراءِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿إِسْحاقَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿يَعْقُوبَ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; in the reading with the accusative it is the mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb; and the clause is maʿṭūf.

﴿قالَتْ﴾ a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿وَيْلَتى﴾ the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, and the yāʾ of the speaker has been turned into an alif. ﴿أَأَلِدُ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿وَأَنَا عَجُوزٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَهذا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and ذا is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿بَعْلِي﴾ khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, its appearance prevented by the place being occupied by the fitting vowel. ﴿شَيْخاً﴾ ḥāl. ﴿إِنَّ هذا﴾ inna, and the demonstrative is its noun. ﴿لَشَيْءٌ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and شيء is khabar. ﴿عَجِيبٌ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), and the clause is resumptive.

﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَتَعْجَبِينَ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the yāʾ is fāʿil, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿مِنْ أَمْرِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تعجبين. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿رَحْمَتُ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَبَرَكاتُهُ﴾ conjoined to رحمة, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿أَهْلَ﴾ the one addressed, accusative (manṣūb), with the vocative particle يا omitted. ﴿الْبَيْتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّهُ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its two khabars, and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:74-77.t:
﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لما al-ḥīniyya ("when") is an adverb of time. ﴿ذَهَبَ عَنْ إِبْراهِيمَ الرَّوْعُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ذهب, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَجاءَتْهُ الْبُشْرى﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its postponed fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur), and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿يُجادِلُنا﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي قَوْمِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يجادلنا. ﴿لُوطٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّ إِبْراهِيمَ﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَحَلِيمٌ أَوَّاهٌ مُنِيبٌ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and what follows it are khabars (predicates) of inna.

﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿إِبْراهِيمُ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative by the vocative, and the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿أَعْرِضْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَنْ هذا﴾ the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh) and ذا is a demonstrative; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أعرض. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿جاءَ أَمْرُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَإِنَّهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and inna and its noun. ﴿آتِيهِمْ﴾ khabar, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness (thiql), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ fāʿil of آتيهم. ﴿غَيْرُ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of عذاب. ﴿مَرْدُودٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.

﴿وَلَمَّا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and لما al-ḥīniyya is an adverb of time. ﴿جاءَتْ رُسُلُنا لُوطاً﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿سِيءَ﴾ a passive past verb, its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) latent. ﴿بِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to سيء, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of لما. ﴿وَضاقَ بِهِمْ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the statement is conjoined to سيء بهم. ﴿ذَرْعاً﴾ tamyīz (specification). ﴿وَقالَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿هذا يَوْمٌ﴾ the hāʾ is for drawing attention, and ذا is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject), and يوم is its khabar. ﴿عَصِيبٌ﴾ an adjective, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb).

daas-irab:78-80.t:
﴿وَجاءَهُ قَوْمُهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb, its fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its postponed fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يُهْرَعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَمِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), min is a preposition, and قبل is an adverb of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يعملون. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi [Translator's note: so in the source; given the circumstantial wāw, the clause is presumably meant to be a ḥāl]. ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ السَّيِّئاتِ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the wāw is fāʿil, and السيئات is mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) by the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural, and the clause is the khabar (predicate).

﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿يا قَوْمِ﴾ yā is a vocative particle, and قوم is the one addressed (munādā), accusative with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the dropped yāʾ of the speaker. ﴿هؤُلاءِ بَناتِي﴾ the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ (subject), and بناتي is khabar, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿هُنَّ أَطْهَرُ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is a second khabar. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أطهر. ﴿فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تُخْزُونِ﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by lā; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya) and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿فِي ضَيْفِي﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تخزوني. ﴿أَلَيْسَ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and laysa is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿رَجُلٌ﴾ the noun of laysa. ﴿رَشِيدٌ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), and the clause is resumptive.

﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَقَدْ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer to an omitted oath, and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿عَلِمْتَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿لَنا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿فِي بَناتِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾid) preposition. ﴿حَقٍّ﴾ mubtadaʾ, genitive in form and nominative in position, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿وَإِنَّكَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial, and inna and its noun, and the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿لَتَعْلَمُ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿نُرِيدُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause).

﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَوْ﴾ a particle containing the sense of condition, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿أَنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿لِي﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the fronted khabar of anna. ﴿بِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted ḥāl. ﴿قُوَّةً﴾ the noun of anna; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is the fāʿil of an omitted verb, its implied form being "ثبت", and the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿آوِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness (thiql), with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿إِلى رُكْنٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to آوي. ﴿شَدِيدٍ﴾ an adjective.

daas-irab:81-83.t:
﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿لُوطُ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative by the vocative. ﴿إِنَّا رُسُلُ﴾ inna and its noun [and its khabar (predicate)]; the clause, together with what precedes it, is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَنْ يَصِلُوا﴾ lan is accusative-governing, and an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يصلوا. ﴿فَأَسْرِ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿بِأَهْلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أسر, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِقِطْعٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنَ اللَّيْلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an adjective (ṣifa) of قطع. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive. ﴿يَلْتَفِتْ﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يلتفت. ﴿أَحَدٌ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿امْرَأَتَكَ﴾ excepted (mustathnā) by إلا, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿مُصِيبُها﴾ a fronted khabar, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is the khabar of إنه. ﴿أَصابَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّ مَوْعِدَهُمُ الصُّبْحُ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَلَيْسَ الصُّبْحُ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and laysa is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and الصبح is its noun. ﴿بِقَرِيبٍ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾid) preposition, and قريب is the khabar, genitive in form and accusative in position.

﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and لما al-ḥīniyya ("when") is an adverb of time. ﴿جاءَ أَمْرُنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿جَعَلْنا عالِيَها﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of لما. ﴿سافِلَها﴾ second mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأَمْطَرْنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿عَلَيْها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أمطرنا. ﴿حِجارَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْ سِجِّيلٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an adjective of حجارة. ﴿مَنْضُودٍ﴾ a second adjective of حجارة, and the clause is maʿṭūf [Translator's note: so in the source; منضود is genitive and is usually taken as an adjective of سجيل]. ﴿مُسَوَّمَةً﴾ an adjective of حجارة. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place attached to مسومة. ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and mā is negating, operating like laysa. ﴿هِيَ﴾ the noun of mā. ﴿مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بعيد. ﴿بِبَعِيدٍ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant preposition, and بعيد, genitive in form and accusative in position, is its khabar, and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:84-85.t:
﴿وَإِلى مَدْيَنَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "أرسلنا إلى مدين". ﴿أَخاهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿شُعَيْباً﴾ badal (substitute). ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا قَوْمِ﴾ yā is a vocative particle, and قوم is accusative by the vocative, the sign of its accusative being an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the dropped yāʾ of the speaker. ﴿اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is its mafʿūl bihi; the clause, together with what precedes it, is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿ما لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلهٍ﴾ mā operates like laysa; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the fronted khabar (predicate); min is a redundant (zāʾid) preposition, and إله is its noun, genitive in form and nominative in position. ﴿غَيْرُهُ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of إله, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَنْقُصُوا﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, and the wāw is fāʿil. ﴿الْمِكْيالَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَالْمِيزانَ﴾ conjoined to المكيال, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl) with no grammatical position. ﴿أَراكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur); the kāf is mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿بِخَيْرٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أراكم. ﴿وَإِنِّي أَخافُ﴾ conjoined to what precedes. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أخاف. ﴿عَذابَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَوْمٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مُحِيطٍ﴾ an adjective.

﴿وَيا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and yā is a vocative particle. ﴿قَوْمِ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) with an implied fatḥa on the letter before the dropped yāʾ of the speaker. ﴿أَوْفُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الْمِكْيالَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَالْمِيزانَ﴾ conjoined to المكيال. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَبْخَسُوا﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive by the dropping of the nūn. ﴿النَّاسَ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَشْياءَهُمْ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَلا تَعْثَوْا﴾ conjoined to ولا تبخسوا. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to لا تعثوا. ﴿مُفْسِدِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause is maʿṭūf.

daas-irab:86-88.t:
﴿بَقِيَّتُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾ khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) خير, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna and its noun, and the clause is initial. ﴿مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ khabar, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and mā is negating, operating like laysa. ﴿أَنَا﴾ its noun. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to حفيظ. ﴿بِحَفِيظٍ﴾ the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and حفيظ is the khabar, genitive in form and accusative in position.

﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿شُعَيْبُ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative by the vocative. ﴿أَصَلاتُكَ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and صلاتك is mubtadaʾ, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تَأْمُرُكَ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is the khabar. ﴿أَنْ﴾ accusative-governing. ﴿نَتْرُكَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) with a latent fāʿil; an and what follows it are accusative by removal of the preposition. ﴿ما﴾ relative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَعْبُدُ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿آباؤُنا﴾ fāʿil, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿أَنْ﴾ accusative-governing. ﴿نَفْعَلَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the accusative with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿فِي أَمْوالِنا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نفعل, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ما﴾ relative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿نَشؤُا﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl) with no grammatical position. ﴿لَأَنْتَ الْحَلِيمُ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is the khabar of إنك. ﴿الرَّشِيدُ﴾ a second khabar.

﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا قَوْمِ﴾ its parsing has just preceded. ﴿أَرَأَيْتُمْ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause, together with what precedes it, is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿كُنْتُ﴾ kāna and its noun, and the clause is initial, with no grammatical position. ﴿عَلى بَيِّنَةٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّي﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بينة, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَرَزَقَنِي﴾ a past verb; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), the yāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to رزقني. ﴿رِزْقاً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿حَسَناً﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and mā is negating. ﴿أُرِيدُ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative with a latent fāʿil. ﴿إِنْ﴾ accusative-governing [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿إِنْ﴾; the word in the verse is أَنْ]. ﴿أُخالِفَكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb in the accusative; the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the mafʿūl bihi of أريد. ﴿إِلى ما﴾ mā is relative; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أخالفكم. ﴿أَنْهاكُمْ﴾ a past verb [Translator's note: so in the source; أنهى is an imperfect verb], and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَنْهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنهاكم, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿إِنْ﴾ a particle of negation. ﴿أُرِيدُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿الْإِصْلاحَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾ maṣdariyya (infinitival). ﴿اسْتَطَعْتُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; mā and what follows it are in the position of the accusative as an adverb of time. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and mā is negating. ﴿تَوْفِيقِي﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by the bāʾ; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to توكلت, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿وَإِلَيْهِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنيب. ﴿أُنِيبُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is maʿṭūf.

daas-irab:89-92.t:
﴿وَيا قَوْمِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, yā is a vocative particle, and قوم is the one addressed (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿لا﴾ prohibitive. ﴿يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿شِقاقِي﴾ fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَنْ﴾ accusative-governing. ﴿يُصِيبَكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb in the accusative, and the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi; an and what follows it are in the position of the accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi of يجرمنكم. ﴿مِثْلُ﴾ fāʿil, nominative. ﴿ما﴾ relative, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَصابَ﴾ a past verb and a latent (mustatir) fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿قَوْمِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿نُوحٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَوْ قَوْمَ هُودٍ أَوْ قَوْمَ صالِحٍ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and mā is negating, operating like laysa. ﴿قَوْمِ﴾ its noun. ﴿لُوطٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) بعيد. ﴿بِبَعِيدٍ﴾ the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and بعيد is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position, the khabar (predicate) of mā, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَاسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿تُوبُوا﴾ conjoined to استغفروا. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to توبوا. ﴿إِنَّ رَبِّي﴾ inna and its noun, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿رَحِيمٌ وَدُودٌ﴾ the two khabars of inna, and the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl) with no grammatical position.

﴿قالُوا﴾ an imperative verb [Translator's note: so in the source; قالوا is a past verb] and its fāʿil. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿شُعَيْبُ﴾ the one addressed, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿نَفْقَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative with a latent fāʿil. ﴿كَثِيراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ mā is relative; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نفقه. ﴿تَقُولُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَإِنَّا﴾ the wāw is circumstantial, and inna and its noun, and the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿لَنَراكَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur); the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿فِينا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ضعيفا. ﴿ضَعِيفاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi [Translator's note: so in the source; if نرى is visual, ضعيفا is a ḥāl; if it is of knowledge, it is the second mafʿūl bihi]. ﴿وَلَوْلا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and لولا is a particle of non-occurrence owing to occurrence (imtināʿ li-wujūd). ﴿رَهْطُكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi, and the khabar is omitted, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَرَجَمْناكَ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer of لولا, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive-governing condition. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and mā is negating, operating like laysa. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ its noun. ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to عزيز. ﴿بِعَزِيزٍ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant preposition, and عزيز is the khabar, genitive in form and accusative in position, and the clause is maʿṭūf.

﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿قَوْمِ﴾ the one addressed, accusative, the sign of its accusative being an implied fatḥa on the letter before the dropped yāʾ of the speaker. ﴿أَرَهْطِي﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and رهطي is mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَعَزُّ﴾ khabar. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أعز. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by min; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أعز. ﴿وَاتَّخَذْتُمُوهُ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of ḥāl, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the wāw is for lengthening (ishbāʿ), and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿وَراءَكُمْ﴾ an adverb of place attached to اتخذتموه, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ظِهْرِيًّا﴾ ḥāl. ﴿إِنَّ رَبِّي﴾ inna and its noun, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is a causal explanation. ﴿بِما﴾ mā is relative; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to محيط. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مُحِيطٌ﴾ the khabar of inna.

daas-irab:93-96.t:
﴿وَيا قَوْمِ﴾ its parsing has just preceded. ﴿اعْمَلُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿عَلى مَكانَتِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl). ﴿عامِلٌ﴾ khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿سَوْفَ﴾ for deferment (taswīf). ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يَأْتِيهِ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness (thiql), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ postponed fāʿil. ﴿يُخْزِيهِ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of عذاب. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and man is relative, conjoined to the first man. ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كاذِبٌ﴾ khabar, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَارْتَقِبُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿مَعَكُمْ﴾ an adverb of place attached to رقيب, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿رَقِيبٌ﴾ khabar.

﴿وَلَمَّا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and لما al-ḥīniyya ("when") is an adverb of time. ﴿جاءَ أَمْرُنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نَجَّيْنا شُعَيْباً﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the relative noun is conjoined to شعيبا. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مَعَهُ﴾ an adverb of place attached to نجينا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِرَحْمَةٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿مِنَّا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of رحمة. ﴿وَأَخَذَتِ الَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine, and a relative noun, fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿الصَّيْحَةُ﴾ postponed fāʿil. ﴿فَأَصْبَحُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and أصبح and its noun. ﴿فِي دِيارِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جاثمين, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿جاثِمِينَ﴾ khabar. ﴿كَأَنْ﴾ lightened from كأن, its noun omitted, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَمْ﴾ a jussive-governing particle. ﴿يَغْنَوْا﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of كأن. ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يغنوا. ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of opening (istiftāḥ) and drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿بُعْداً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿لِمَدْيَنَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بعدا. ﴿كَما﴾ the kāf is a preposition and mā is maṣdariyya (infinitival); mā and what follows it are in the position of the genitive, and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to an omitted adjective of بعد. ﴿بَعِدَتْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿ثَمُودُ﴾ the fāʿil of بعدت.

﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the lām occurs in the answer to the oath, and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿أَرْسَلْنا مُوسى﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with an implied fatḥa on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur), and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أرسلنا. ﴿وَسُلْطانٍ﴾ conjoined to آياتنا. ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾ an adjective.

daas-irab:97-100.t:
﴿إِلى فِرْعَوْنَ﴾ فرعون is a diptote, genitive (majrūr) by the fatḥa; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أرسلنا. ﴿وَمَلَائِهِ﴾ conjoined to فرعون, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَاتَّبَعُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَمْرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِرْعَوْنَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and mā is negating, operating like laysa. ﴿أَمْرَ﴾ the noun of mā [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿أَمْرَ﴾ with fatḥa; as the noun of mā it is أَمْرُ, nominative]. ﴿فِرْعَوْنَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿بِرَشِيدٍ﴾ the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and رشيد is the khabar (predicate), genitive in form and accusative in position, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

﴿يَقْدُمُ قَوْمَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl) with no grammatical position. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to يقدم. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَأَوْرَدَهُمُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its first mafʿūl bihi, with a latent fāʿil. ﴿النَّارَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَبِئْسَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb for expressing blame (inshāʾ al-dhamm). ﴿الْوِرْدُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿الْمَوْرُودُ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿وَأُتْبِعُوا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a passive past verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي هذِهِ﴾ the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and ذا [Translator's note: so in the source; the demonstrative here is ذه] is in the position of the genitive by the preposition; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أتبعوا. ﴿لَعْنَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and يوم is an adverb of time attached to أتبعوا. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِئْسَ﴾ a past verb for expressing blame. ﴿الرِّفْدُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿الْمَرْفُودُ﴾ an adjective, and the clause is resumptive.

﴿ذلِكَ﴾ ذا is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the kāf is for address. ﴿مِنْ أَنْباءِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿الْقُرى﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نَقُصُّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is a second khabar. ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نقصه. ﴿مِنْها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿قائِمٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَحَصِيدٌ﴾ conjoined to قائم, and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:101-105.t:
﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and mā is negating. ﴿ظَلَمْناهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lākin is a particle of rectification (istidrāk). ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction and mā is negating. ﴿أَغْنَتْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿عَنْهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أغنت. ﴿آلِهَتُهُمُ﴾ fāʿil, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الَّتِي﴾ a relative noun, an adjective (ṣifa) of آلهتهم. ﴿يَدْعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾid) preposition. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, genitive in form and accusative in position. ﴿لَمَّا﴾ al-ḥīniyya ("when"), an adverb of time. ﴿جاءَ أَمْرُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and mā is negating. ﴿زادُوهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿غَيْرَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿تَتْبِيبٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive.

﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, the kāf is a preposition, and ذا is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿أَخْذُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb of time containing the sense of condition. ﴿أَخْذُ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿أَخْذُ﴾ here; the word in the verse is the verb أَخَذَ]. ﴿الْقُرى﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur). ﴿وَهِيَ ظالِمَةٌ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿إِنَّ أَخْذَهُ أَلِيمٌ﴾ inna and its noun, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and أليم is the first khabar, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿شَدِيدٌ﴾ a second khabar. ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذلِكَ﴾ inna, and the demonstrative is genitive by في; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿لَآيَةً﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and آية is the postponed noun of inna. ﴿لِمَنْ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the genitive; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to آية. ﴿خافَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَذابَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْآخِرَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿ذلِكَ يَوْمٌ﴾ the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ and يوم is khabar, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَجْمُوعٌ﴾ an adjective of يوم. ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to مجموع. ﴿النَّاسُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of مجموع. ﴿وَذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿يَوْمٌ﴾ khabar, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿مَشْهُودٌ﴾ an adjective of يوم, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes.

﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and mā is negating. ﴿نُؤَخِّرُهُ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿لِأَجَلٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نؤخره. ﴿مَعْدُودٍ﴾ an adjective. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to يأتي. ﴿يَأْتِ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness (thiql) [the yāʾ being dropped in the script], and the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا تَكَلَّمُ﴾ lā is negating, and an imperfect verb from which one of its two tāʾs has been dropped, nominative. ﴿نَفْسٌ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿بِإِذْنِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿فَمِنْهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿شَقِيٌّ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَسَعِيدٌ﴾ conjoined to شقي.

daas-irab:106-108.t:
﴿فَأَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and أما is a particle of detailing (tafṣīl) and condition. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿شَقُوا﴾ a past verb, and the wāw is fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فَفِي النَّارِ﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the answer of لما [Translator's note: so in the source; the fāʾ is in the answer of أما], and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of الذين. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿زَفِيرٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَشَهِيقٌ﴾ conjoined. ﴿خالِدِينَ فِيها﴾ ḥāl, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to خالدين. ﴿ما دامَتِ السَّماواتُ﴾ mā is maṣdariyya (infinitival), and دامت is a complete (tāmm) past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine, and السماوات is the fāʿil. ﴿وَالْأَرْضُ﴾ conjoined to السماوات. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿ما﴾ relative, in the position of the accusative, excepted (mustathnā) by إلا. ﴿شاءَ رَبُّكَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ فَعَّالٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِما﴾ mā is relative; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to فعال. ﴿يُرِيدُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is the ṣila.

﴿وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ سُعِدُوا فَفِي الْجَنَّةِ﴾ conjoined to فأما الذين شقوا etc., and parsed like it. ﴿خالِدِينَ﴾ ḥāl. ﴿فِيها ما دامَتِ السَّماواتُ وَالْأَرْضُ إِلَّا ما شاءَ رَبُّكَ﴾ its parsing has preceded. ﴿عَطاءً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "أعطوا عطاء". ﴿غَيْرَ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of عطاء. ﴿مَجْذُوذٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:109-110.t:
﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَكُ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by lā, its noun omitted. ﴿فِي مِرْيَةٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ min is a preposition and mā is relative; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of مرية. ﴿يَعْبُدُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿هؤُلاءِ﴾ the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and أولاء is a demonstrative, fāʿil (agent). ﴿ما يَعْبُدُونَ﴾ mā is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl) of the prohibition, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿كَما﴾ the kāf is a preposition and mā is relative; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), the implied form being "إلا عبادة مثل". ﴿يَعْبُدُ آباؤُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَإِنَّا لَمُوَفُّوهُمْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and inna, with the nā assimilated into it as its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and موفوهم is its khabar, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿نَصِيبَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the maṣdar موفوهم [Translator's note: so in the source; موفّو is an active participle, not a maṣdar], and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿غَيْرَ﴾ ḥāl. ﴿مَنْقُوصٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.

﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, the lām occurs in the answer to the omitted oath, and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿آتَيْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مُوسَى﴾ first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَاخْتُلِفَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a passive past verb. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the verb, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿وَلَوْلا كَلِمَةٌ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and لولا is a non-jussive-governing conditional particle, and a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar is omitted. ﴿سَبَقَتْ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the tāʾ is for the feminine, and the clause is an adjective of كلمة. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to سبقت, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَقُضِيَ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer of لولا, and a passive past verb. ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of place attached to the omitted nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the answer of لولا, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَإِنَّهُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and inna and its noun, and the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿لَفِي شَكٍّ﴾ the shifted lām, and a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to شك. ﴿مُرِيبٍ﴾ an adjective of شك, and the clause is maʿṭūf.

daas-irab:111-113.t:
﴿وَإِنَّ كُلًّا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and inna and its noun. ﴿لَمَّا﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and mā is relative, the khabar (predicate). ﴿لَيُوَفِّيَنَّهُمْ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer to an oath, and an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the hāʾ is its first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿رَبُّكَ﴾ postponed fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَعْمالَهُمْ﴾ the second mafʿūl bihi of يوفينهم, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿بِما﴾ mā is relative; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) خبير. ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿خَبِيرٌ﴾ the khabar of inna.

﴿فَاسْتَقِمْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿كَما﴾ the kāf is a preposition and mā is maṣdariyya (infinitival). ﴿أُمِرْتَ﴾ a passive past verb, and the tāʾ is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the kāf and what follows it, interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of accompaniment (al-maʿiyya), and man is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment). ﴿تابَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مَعَكَ﴾ an adverb of place attached to تاب, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَطْغَوْا﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِما﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition and mā is a relative noun; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بصير. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿بَصِيرٌ﴾ khabar.

﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is resumptive and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَرْكَنُوا﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive by the dropping of the nūn, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَى الَّذِينَ﴾ الذين is a relative noun; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تركنوا. ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فَتَمَسَّكُمُ النَّارُ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation (al-sababiyya), and an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after the fāʾ of causation, and the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿النَّارُ﴾ fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and mā is negating. ﴿لَكُمْ مِنْ دُونِ﴾ both [prepositional phrases] are attached to the omitted fronted khabar. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾid) preposition. ﴿أَوْلِياءَ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), genitive in form and nominative in position. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿تُنْصَرُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf.

daas-irab:114-116.t:
﴿وَأَقِمِ الصَّلاةَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿طَرَفَيِ﴾ an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ because it is dual, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أقم. ﴿النَّهارِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَزُلَفاً﴾ conjoined to طرفي. ﴿مِنَ اللَّيْلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to زلفا. ﴿إِنَّ الْحَسَناتِ﴾ inna and its noun, accusative by the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural, and the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl) with no grammatical position. ﴿يُذْهِبْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because it is joined to the nūn of the feminine plural, and the nūn is fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿السَّيِّئاتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿ذِكْرى﴾ khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur). ﴿لِلذَّاكِرِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ذكرى. ﴿وَاصْبِرْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause is a causal explanation with no grammatical position. ﴿لا يُضِيعُ﴾ lā is negating, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿أَجْرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

﴿فَلَوْلا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and لولا is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنَ الْقُرُونِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أُولُوا﴾ the noun of kāna, nominative by the wāw because it is treated like the sound masculine plural. ﴿بَقِيَّةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَنْهَوْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of kāna. ﴿عَنِ الْفَسادِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ينهون. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to الفساد. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾ excepted (mustathnā) by إلا. ﴿مِمَّنْ﴾ a relative noun; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of قليلا. ﴿أَنْجَيْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنجينا. ﴿وَاتَّبَعَ﴾ a past verb, and its clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, fāʿil. ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿ما﴾ relative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أُتْرِفُوا﴾ a passive past verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أترفوا. ﴿وَكانُوا مُجْرِمِينَ﴾ kāna, its noun and its khabar, which is accusative by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural, and the clause is maʿṭūf.

daas-irab:117-120.t:
﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and mā is negating. ﴿كانَ رَبُّكَ﴾ kāna and its noun; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِيُهْلِكَ﴾ the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an; the kāf is its first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir) [Translator's note: so in the source; there is no kāf in يهلك, and القرى is its only object]. ﴿الْقُرى﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِظُلْمٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يهلك; an and what follows it are attached to the khabar (predicate) of kāna. ﴿وَأَهْلُها مُصْلِحُونَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive and law is a non-jussive-governing conditional particle. ﴿شاءَ رَبُّكَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿لَجَعَلَ النَّاسَ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer of law, and a past verb and its first mafʿūl bihi, with a latent fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive-governing condition. ﴿أُمَّةً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿واحِدَةً﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿وَلا يَزالُونَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, and the wāw is its noun. ﴿مُخْتَلِفِينَ﴾ khabar, accusative by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the accusative by exception. ﴿رَحِمَ رَبُّكَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَلِذلِكَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and ذا is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive by the lām; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to خلقهم. ﴿خَلَقَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَةُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine and كلمة is fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبُّكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَأَمْلَأَنَّ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer to the oath, and an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, with a latent fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the oath. ﴿جَهَنَّمَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أملأن. ﴿وَالنَّاسِ﴾ conjoined to الجنة. ﴿أَجْمَعِينَ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis), genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ.

﴿وَكُلًّا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and كلا is a fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿نَقُصُّ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the verb. ﴿مِنْ أَنْباءِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نقص. ﴿الرُّسُلِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ما﴾ relative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿نُثَبِّتُ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ) with a latent fāʿil. ﴿بِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نثبت. ﴿فُؤادَكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَجاءَكَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي هذِهِ﴾ ذا [Translator's note: so in the source; the demonstrative here is ذه] is a demonstrative; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جاءك. ﴿الْحَقُّ﴾ postponed fāʿil. ﴿وَمَوْعِظَةٌ﴾ conjoined to الحق. ﴿وَذِكْرى﴾ conjoined to what precedes; it is nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur). ﴿لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ذكرى.

daas-irab:121-123.t: ﴿وَقُلْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) قل. ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ lā is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿اعْمَلُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿عَلى مَكانَتِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to اعملوا, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna, and nā is its noun. ﴿عامِلُونَ﴾ khabar (predicate), nominative by the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿وَلِلَّهِ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿غَيْبُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to السماوات. ﴿وَإِلَيْهِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يرجع. ﴿يُرْجَعُ الْأَمْرُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and الأمر is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿كُلُّهُ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿فَاعْبُدْهُ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and an imperative verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), with a latent fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿وَتَوَكَّلْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and it is conjoined to اعبده. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to توكل. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and mā is negating, operating like laysa. ﴿رَبُّكَ﴾ its noun, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِغافِلٍ﴾ the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and غافل is the khabar of mā, genitive in form and accusative in position, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَمَّا﴾ عن is a preposition and mā is a relative noun; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to غافل. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila.

daas-irab:1-3.t: ﴿الر﴾: letters with no grammatical position. ﴿كِتابٌ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هذا كتاب" ("this is a Book"). ﴿أُحْكِمَتْ﴾: a passive past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿آياتُهُ﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of كتاب. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿فُصِّلَتْ﴾: conjoined to أحكمت. ﴿مِنْ لَدُنْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أحكمت. ﴿حَكِيمٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿خَبِيرٍ﴾: badal (substitute). ﴿أَلَّا﴾: the subjunctive-governing an, and lā is negating. ﴿تَعْبُدُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَلَّا﴾ [Translator's note: so written in the source; the word here is إِلَّا]: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the Name of Majesty is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِنَّنِي﴾: inna and its noun; the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نذير. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نذير. ﴿نَذِيرٌ﴾: the khabar of إني. ﴿وَبَشِيرٌ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) on نذير; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَأَنِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an is conjoined to the an in His saying, Exalted is He, ألا تعبدوا. ﴿اسْتَغْفِرُوا﴾: an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿رَبَّكُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿تُوبُوا﴾: conjoined to استغفروا. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to توبوا. ﴿يُمَتِّعْكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the command (jawāb al-ṭalab); the kāf is mafʿūl bihi and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿مَتاعاً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿حَسَناً﴾: an adjective. ﴿إِلى أَجَلٍ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يمتعكم. ﴿مُسَمًّى﴾: an adjective of أجل, genitive (majrūr) with an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif because of impossibility. ﴿وَيُؤْتِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb conjoined to يمتعكم; it is jussive like it, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿كُلَّ﴾: first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ذِي﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the yāʾ because it is one of the five nouns. ﴿فَضْلٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَضْلَهُ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأَنِ﴾ [Translator's note: so written in the source; the word in the verse is وَإِنْ]: the wāw is resumptive and what follows it is resumptive speech; in is conditional. ﴿تَوَلَّوْا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿فَإِنِّي﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and inna and its noun; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿أَخافُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أخاف. ﴿عَذابَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَوْمٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كَبِيرٍ﴾: an adjective.

daas-irab:4-6.t: ﴿إِلَى اللَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate), and مرجعكم is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and هو is a mubtadaʾ; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿عَلى كُلِّ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قَدِيرٌ﴾: khabar. ﴿أَلا﴾: a particle of drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾: inna and its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَثْنُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the khabar. ﴿صُدُورَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِيَسْتَخْفُوا﴾: the lām is the lām of cause (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after the lām of cause, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the lām and what follows it are attached to يثنون. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يثنون. ﴿أَلا﴾: a particle of drawing attention. ﴿حِينَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to يعلم. ﴿يَسْتَغْشُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ثِيابَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿ما يُسِرُّونَ﴾: mā is relative, mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يُسِرُّونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative. ﴿وَما يُعْلِنُونَ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: inna and its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾: khabar. ﴿بِذاتِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to عليم. ﴿الصُّدُورِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive and mā is negating. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿دَابَّةٍ﴾: a noun genitive in form and nominative in position, mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿رِزْقُها﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the khabar of دابة. ﴿وَيَعْلَمُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿مُسْتَقَرَّها﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَمُسْتَوْدَعَها﴾: conjoined to مستقرها. ﴿كُلٌّ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِي كِتابٍ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of كتاب. Beginning with an indefinite noun is permissible because it contains the sense of generality, i.e. "all of that is in a Book".

daas-irab:7-8.t: ﴿وَهُوَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, khabar (predicate). ﴿خَلَقَ السَّماواتِ﴾: a past verb and its object, accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) on السموات. ﴿فِي سِتَّةِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) خلق. ﴿أَيَّامٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَكانَ عَرْشُهُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and kāna and its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَلَى الْماءِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ﴾: the lām is the lām of cause (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an after the lām of cause; the kāf is its first object and the fāʿil is latent; an and what follows it, interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), are in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the two are attached to خلق. ﴿أَيُّكُمْ﴾: أيّ is a mubtadaʾ, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَحْسَنُ﴾: khabar. ﴿عَمَلًا﴾: tamyīz (specification);
